body.input: But as, you know, if we get in contact

body.input: But if you're part of an economy of 10 million people,

body.input: there's much more room for specialization.

body.input: You can make a car, you can make a house

body.input: And that relies on the division of labor.

body.input: You know, you can, and you trade that thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: That's the thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: In economics, we don't make quantitative predictions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: We cannot do that because we don't have experiments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: But we can understand how the world actually works

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: with humility.

body.input: that's gonna make me Superman.

body.input: There's a lot more to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: So humility manifests itself in economics

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And then you start actually trying to solve problems,

body.input: you know, trying to actually calculate them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And you realize nobody can have that ability

body.input: because the difference ultimately comes down to the fact

body.input: And the reason we can't have experiments is that

body.input: And because particles of a gas are just dumb matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And so, you know, you kick matter in a certain way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: They have a will inside them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And this is really, this is the humility to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: are also human being just like you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: uses for moving money around the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: so basically the US government can sanction you off of SWIFT

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: as they've done with Russian banks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: as they've done with Iran

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and as they've done with Afghanistan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: So effectively, I mean, this is really the catastrophe

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: of the current monetary system

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: is that in order to be able to trade

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: as a member, as a citizen of your country,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: you need your monopoly local central bank

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: to be on good terms with the US government

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: so that they would let them operate it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And this is really like on top of the aspects

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: of the hardness of money,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: this is the other really powerful thing about Bitcoin

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: which is that it's just purely a technological thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: It doesn't matter if you're Russian, if you're Iranian,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: if you're American, if you're Chinese, it's a technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And so it's like a spoon or a knife or a car,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: you operate it properly and it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And so with Bitcoin, it's the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: It doesn't care about your passport.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: If you have the private key, you click send

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and the money goes, well, it doesn't really go,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: but effectively it does go anywhere at once

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and the money can move without having to abide

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: by political situations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And the point here is not to bash US foreign policy

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: much as that might be deserved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: I'm just going to discuss it

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: from a kind of technical perspective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: It has to be a political system with fiat

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: because ultimately it relies on credit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And then the government is the one that has the guns

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and the government is going to decide

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: who gets to pay their loans anyway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And the government's going to have to make its own rules

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: about who gets to play and who doesn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And so it has to be political as this kind of fiat system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And when I wrote the Bitcoin standard,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: initially I used to be much more of a gold bug.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And in my mind, gold bugs have spent the last 50 years

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: saying the global monetary system

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: is gonna collapse next week

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and we're gonna go back to a gold standard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And writing the fiat standard gave me a very good appreciation

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: for why this hasn't happened

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and why it's not very likely to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: I think the reason is, as I said earlier,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: just gold is very expensive to move around

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and perhaps more importantly, it's very expensive to verify.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: That's really the problem with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: It's very expensive to verify

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: that the gold that you're receiving is original gold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: So the only way to do this properly

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: is to melt the gold bars down and recast them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: which is pretty expensive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: So we have this situation now where Russia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: which is one of the biggest economies in the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: has been kicked off to varying degrees

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: off of the global monetary system

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and the US has confiscated their reserves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And I don't have political opinions about the war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: It's not something I'm very familiar with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: It's outside of my area of expertise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: I'm just analyzing the monetary aspects of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: It is, on the one hand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: whether you think the war is justified or the sanctions

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: are justified is not something I can opine on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: but the implication of this is that effectively

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: the US might be shooting itself in the foot

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: because it's telling everybody in the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: your money in our system is not really your money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: It's just a token to play in our arcade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And at any point in time, if you misbehave,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: we kick you out of the arcade and we take your tokens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And so, I mean, this is something that China, Russia, Iran,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and many countries have made a lot of noise about

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: over the past decades.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: It got real this year,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: but it's been decades of China, Iran, and Russia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: to some extent saying that, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: we wanna build an alternative to the US dollar-based system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And yet they haven't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And I think there's very good reasons they haven't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And the reason is, what do you do with it based on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: How do you build it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: So you can do a credit-based system based on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: but then who's going to be the big boss?

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Is it gonna be China?

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Is it gonna be Russia?

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Is it gonna be Iran?

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Is it gonna be India?

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: None of these countries wants to be, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: they don't wanna jump out of the US-based system

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: to get into somebody else's base system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: So China doesn't wanna use a Russian system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Russia doesn't wanna use a Chinese system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And so therefore you can't use

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: their own central bank's currencies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Don't you think they have enough leverage,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: India, China, Russia combined with several other nations

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: have enough leverage and incentive to create their own system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: So any one player, yes, but if they collaborate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Yeah, but then, okay, so what are you based on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Like who's going to be the boss?

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Who's going to be the one who can-

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Well, in this case, China, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Because China is becoming increasingly

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: an economic power in the world that it's hard to deny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Yes, it's true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And it's the most likely scenario perhaps,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: if we were to witness something like this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: is going to be a Chinese-based system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: So is it possible to have like a split

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: in what is the driving currency of the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: It's possible, but I don't think it's sustainable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Again, money wants to be won.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And that's the kind of thing that I argue in that seminar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: So we could see this emerge based around the yuan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And likely, I mean, Russia is obviously going

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: to hurt economically from what happened

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: from the confiscation of the reserves and from the sanctions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: So it's not going to be in a position.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And of course, because it's outside of the US-based system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: it's not in the strongest negotiating position

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: with the Chinese.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: So the Chinese might be able to get them

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: to join their yuan-based system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: But I don't think that's sustainable in the long run

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: because these governments can issue their laws

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and make their designs and then make their monetary systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: But ultimately, there are billions of Chinese people

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and billions of dollar-based people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and they're going to want to trade with one another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And the power to want to trade with one another

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: is too strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Like, we can't just split the world economy

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: into two monetary systems that don't trade with one another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: So then they're going to want to trade with one another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Or the dark possibility is it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: the inability to trade as opposed to being

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: a forcing function for trade,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: it become a forcing function for conflict

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: in cyberspace and potentially hot war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: Yes, this is the scary part of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And this is basically how World War II happened,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: because there's an old historian who used to say when,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: I think his name is Otto Mallory,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and I quote him in the Bitcoin Standard,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: if goods don't cross borders, then bombs will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: If people trade with one another,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: they have an incentive for each other's wellbeing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and then they have less of an incentive to fight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And it was the death of global trade in the 1930s

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: because of the failure of the fiat system

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: that brought about the rise of the populism

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and the rise of all those leaders that hated each other

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: and helped finance the war and bring it about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: So that is the scary possibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: And of course, you can't discount that

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: with all of the escalation that you see,

metadata.title: Podcast: Saifedean Ammous: Bitcoin, Anarchy, and Austrian Economics | Lex Fridman Podcast #284

body.input: that is a possibility that it could turn into a real war.

body.input: which is kind of the role of the scientist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: the people that observe the magic trick don't know,

body.input: from every other card in the deck.

body.input: So they do that imaginary.

body.input: And I said, do you want to shuffle it again?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So do you think it's possible that there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: that could be robotic type systems roaming our bodies

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: sort of long-term and be able to deliver

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: certain kinds of drugs in the future?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: You see, do you see that kind of future?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Someday, I don't think we're very close to it yet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: but someday, you know, that that's nanotechnology

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and that would mean even miniaturizing

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: some of the things that I just discussed

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and we're certainly not at that point yet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: but someday I expect we will be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So some of it is just the shrinking of the technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: That's a part of it, that's one of the things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: In general, what role do you see AI sort of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: there's a lot of work now with using data

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: to make intelligent, create systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: that make intelligent decisions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Do you see any of that data-driven kind of computing systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: having a role in any part of this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: into the delivery of drugs, the design of drugs

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and any part of the chain?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I do, I think that AI can be useful

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: in a number of parts of the chain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I mean, one, I think if you get a large amount

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: of information, you know, say you have some chemical data

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: because you've done high throughput screens

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and let's, I'll just make this up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: but let's say I have, I'm trying to come up with a drug

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: to treat disease X, whatever that disease is

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and I have a test for that and hopefully a fast test

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and let's say I test 10,000 chemical substances

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and a couple work, most of them don't work,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: some maybe work a little, but if I had,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: with the right kind of artificial intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: maybe you could look at the chemical structures

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and look at what works and see

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: if there's certain commonalities, look at what doesn't work

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and see what commonalities there are

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and then maybe use that somehow to predict

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: the next generation of things that you would test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: As a tangent, what are your thoughts

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: on our society's relationship with pharmaceutical drugs?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Do we, and perhaps I apologize

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: if this is a philosophical, broader question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: but do we over-rely in them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Do we improperly prescribe them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: In what ways is the system working well

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and what way can it improve?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Well, I think pharmaceutical drugs are really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Life expectancy and life quality of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: over many, many years has increased tremendously

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and I think that's a really good thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I think one thing that would also be good

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: is if we could extend that more and more

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: to people in the developing world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: which is something that our lab has been doing

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: with the Gates Foundation, or trying to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So I think ways in which it could improve,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I mean, if there was some way to reduce costs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: you know, that's certainly an issue

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: people are concerned about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: If there was some way to help people in poor countries,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: that would also be a good thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And then of course we still need to make better drugs

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: for so many diseases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I mean, cancer, diabetes, I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: there's heart disease and rare diseases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: There are many, many situations where it would be great

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: if we could do better and help more people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Can we talk about another exciting space,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: which is tissue engineering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: What is tissue engineering or regenerative medicine?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Yeah, so tissue engineering or regenerative medicine

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: have to do with building an organ or tissue from scratch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So, you know, someday maybe we can build a liver,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: you know, or make new cartilage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Also would enable you to, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: someday create organs on a chip,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: which people, we and others are trying to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: which might lead to better drug testing

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and maybe less testing on animals or people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Organs on a chip, that sounds fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So what are the various ways to generate tissue?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And how do, so, you know, the one is of course

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: from stem cells, is there other methods?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: What are the different possible flavors here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Yeah, well, I think, I mean, there's multiple components.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: One is having generally some type of scaffold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: That's what Jay Vikanti and I started many, many years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And then on that scaffold,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: you might put different cell types,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: which could be a cartilage cell, a bone cell,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: could be a stem cell that might differentiate

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: into different things, could be more than one cell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And the scaffold, sorry to interrupt,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: is kind of like a canvas that it's a structure

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: that you can, on which the cells can grow?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I think that's a good explanation of what you just did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I'll have to use that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: The canvas, that's good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Yeah, so I think that that's fair.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: You know, and the chip could be such a canvas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: could be fibers that are made of plastics

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: that you'd put in the body someday.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And when you say chip, do you mean electronic chip?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Like- Not necessarily.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: It could be though, but it doesn't have to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: It could just be a structure that's not in vivo,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: so to speak, that's outside the body.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So is there- Canvas is not a bad word.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So is there a possibility to weave into this canvas

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: a computational component?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So if we talk about electronic chips,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: some ability to sense, control some aspect of this

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: growth process for the tissue?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I would say the answer to that is yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I think right now people are working mostly

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: on validating these kinds of chips for saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: well, it does work as effectively or hopefully

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: as just putting something in the body.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: But I think someday what you suggested,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: you certainly would be possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So what kind of tissues can we engineer today?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: What would, yeah, what kind of tissues?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Yeah, well, so skin's already been made

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and approved by the FDA through advanced clinical trials,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: like what are called phase three trials

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: that are at complete or near completion

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: for making new blood vessels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: One of my former students, Laura Nicholson,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: led a lot of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So that's amazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So human skin can be grown.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: That's already approved in the entire FDA process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So that means, one, that means you can grow that tissue

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and do various kinds of experiments

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: in terms of drugs and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: But what does that, does that mean that some kind of healing

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and treatment of different conditions

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: for unhuman beings?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Yes, I mean, they've been approved now for,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I mean, different groups have made them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: different companies and different professors,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: but they've been approved for burn victims

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and for patients with diabetic skin ulcers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: That's amazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Okay, so skin, what else?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Well, at different stages,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: people are like skin, blood vessels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: There's clinical trials going now

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: for helping patients hear better,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: for patients that might be paralyzed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: for patients that have different eye problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I mean, and different groups have worked on

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: just about everything, new liver, new kidneys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I mean, there have been all kinds of work done in this area.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Some of it's early, but there's certainly a lot of activity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: What about neural tissue?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: The nervous system and even the brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Well, there have been people out of working on that too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: We've done a little bit with that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: but there are people who've done a lot on neural stem cells.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I know Evan Snyder, who's been one of our collaborators

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: on some of our spinal cord work, has done work like that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and there have been other people as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Is there challenges for the,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: when it is part of the human body,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: is there challenges to getting the body

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: to accept this new tissue that's being generated?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: How do you solve that kind of challenge?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: There can be problems with accepting it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I think maybe in particular,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: you might mean rejection by the body.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So there are multiple ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: that people are trying to deal with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: One way is, which was what we've done with Dan Anderson,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: who was one of my former post-docs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and I mentioned this a little bit before for pancreas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: is encapsulating the cells so immune cells or antibodies

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: can't get in and attack them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So that's a way to protect them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Other strategies could be making the cells non-immunogenic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: which might be done by different either techniques,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: which might mask them, or using some gene editing approaches.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: So there are different ways that people are trying to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And of course, if you use the patient's own cells

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: or cells from a close relative, that might be another way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: It increases the likelihood that it'll get accepted

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: if you use the patient's own cells.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Yes, and then finally, there's some immunosuppressive drugs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: which will suppress the immune response.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: That's right now what's done, say, for liver transplant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: The fact that this whole thing works is just fascinating,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: at least from my outside perspective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Will we one day be able to regenerate any organ

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: or part of the human body, in your view?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I mean, it's exciting to think about future possibilities

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: of tissue engineering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Do you see some tissues more difficult than others?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: What are the possibilities here?

body.input: Yeah, well, of course, I'm an optimist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: What's your view, what in your view are the strengths

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and what are the drawbacks of the patenting process?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Well, I think for the most part, they're strengths.

body.input: I think that if you didn't have patents,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: especially in medicine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: you'd never get the funding that it takes

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: to make a new drug or a new device.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I mean, which according to Tufts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: to make a new drug costs over $2 billion right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And nobody would even come close to giving you that money,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: any of that money, if it weren't for the patent system

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: because then anybody else could do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: That then leads to the negative though.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Sometimes somebody does have a very successful drug

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and you certainly wanna try to make it available

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: to everybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And so the patent system allows it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: allowed it to happen in the first place,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: but maybe it'll impede it after a little bit

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: or certainly to some people or to some companies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: once it is out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: What's the, on the point of the cost,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: of the $2 billion of making the drug?

body.input: Human clinical trials.

body.input: That is by far the most expensive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: In terms of money or pain or both?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Well, money, but pain goes, it's hard to know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: I mean, but usually doing, proving things that are,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: proving that something new is safe and effective in people

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: is almost always the biggest expense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Could you linger on that for just a little longer

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and describe what it takes to prove

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: for people that don't know in general,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: what it takes to prove that something is effective on humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Well, you'd have to take a particular disease,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: but the process is you start out with,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: usually you start out with cells,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: then you'd go to animal models.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Usually you have to do a couple animal models.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And of course the animal models aren't perfect for humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And then you have to do three sets of clinical trials

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: at a minimum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: A phase one trial to show that it's safe

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: in a small number of patients.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: A phase two trial to show that it's effective

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: in a small number of patients.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And a phase three trial to show that it's safe

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and effective in a large number of patients.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And that could end up being hundreds

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: or thousands of patients.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And they have to be really carefully controlled studies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And you'd have to manufacture the drug,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: you'd have to really watch those patients.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: You have to be very concerned that it is gonna be safe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And then you look and see,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: does it treat the disease better

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: than whatever the gold standard was before that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: If there was, assuming there was one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: That's a really interesting line.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Show that it's safe first and then that it's effective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: First do no harm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: First do no harm, that's right.

body.input: how does the patenting process work?

body.input: Yeah, well, you do a certain amount of research,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: though that's not necessarily has to be the case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: But for us, usually it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: Usually we do a certain amount of research

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and make some findings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And we had a hypothesis, let's say we prove it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: or we make some discovery, we invent some technique.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And then we write something up, what's called a disclosure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: We give it to MIT's technology transfer office.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: They then give it to some patent attorneys

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and they use that and plus talking to us

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and work on writing a patent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And then you go back and forth with the USPTO,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: that's the United States Patent and Trademark Office.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And they may not allow it the first, second or third time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: but they will tell you why they don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: And you may adjust it and maybe you'll eventually get it

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Langer: Edison of Medicine | Lex Fridman Podcast #105

body.input: and maybe you won't.

body.input: we have it as good business people.
