body.input: is reading a script back to you and you get furious at this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: and have you ever called this person a moron or wanted to call this person a moron?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: You're not listening to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: Everybody has had the experience of dealing with people who they think are not at their level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: It's just common because that's the way human beings are. That's the way life is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: But we also have a poor estimation of our own intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: We're not always a great...

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: Our judgment of human character of other people is not as good as a battery of tests.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: That's where bias comes in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: That's where our history, our emotions, all of that comes in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: So people on the internet, there's such a thing as the internet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: And people on the internet will call each other dumb all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: That's the worry here is that we give up on people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: We put them in a bin just because of one interaction or some small number of interactions as if that's it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: They're hopeless. That's just in their genetics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: But I think no matter what the science here says, once again,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: that does not mean we should not have compassion for our fellow man.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: That's exactly what the science does say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: It's not opposite of what the science is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: Everything I know about psychology, everything I've learned about intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: everything points to the inexorable conclusion that you have to treat people as individuals respectfully and with compassion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: Because through no fault of their own, some people are not as capable as others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: And you want to turn a blind eye to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: You want to come up with theories about why that might be true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: Fine. I would like to fix some of it as best I can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

body.input: And everybody is deserving of love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Haier: IQ Tests, Human Intelligence, and Group Differences | Lex Fridman Podcast #302

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So for me personally, one that's touched my family

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: 32, 33, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: 32, 33 with Stalin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Maybe you could speak to the universals

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: of the suffering here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: What lessons do you draw from those other famines

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: if you've looked at them or in general about famine

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: that are manufactured by the decisions of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: let's say, authoritarian leaders?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Famine doesn't have to exist

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: or the bulk of famines on this planet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I believe don't have to exist and most of them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: or at least a good number of them are manufactured

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: by the leaders that choose to use famine as a weapon, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And Ukraine is one of the obvious examples right now

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: with siege tactics that are happening

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: in different parts of the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And we built international humanitarian law for a reason,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: many years ago and it continues to be written to this day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And it's there to prevent what's happening

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: in Ukraine right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's there to prevent what's been happening in Yemen

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: for seven years and yet there hasn't been any teeth behind it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And that's what disturbs me is that we can see

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: how these famines are being used as weapons in war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And yet we aren't sort of using the levers of power

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: that exist in order to, I think, to call out

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: in important and powerful ways those who are causing them

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: and to make sure that we hold them accountable

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: on the global stage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Now, to some extent that seems to be happening in Ukraine

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: in a way that hasn't happened for a long time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And that gives me hope, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And yet I don't believe we've done enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And I think the international community needs to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: far more than we are both in Yemen, in Ethiopia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: and in Ukraine right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: There are certain kinds of things that captivate

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: the global attention and it seems like starvation

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: gets people attention more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: The death, of course, is easy to enumerate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: but it's the suffering that's the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah, you know, when we went to film Hunger Ward,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: that was one of the creative questions

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: that I was really concerned about because starvation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: you know, it's not a quick action, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's a long, slow, insidious process, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Just like hunger, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It becomes the most important thing, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: because, you know, someone sitting in a clinic, right,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's almost like it's a quiet suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So you mentioned Ukraine and you mentioned Putin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Well, first off, I think the conflict

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: is just gonna exacerbate sort of the global challenge

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: we have with displacement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: The last entire trilogy I did was about displacement,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: to a great extent, due to war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And this is a huge displacement of human beings,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: regardless of the cause.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And that is gonna sort of have a ripple effect

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: regardless of even if the conflict ended today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So there's that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That's gonna set up a whole nother strain

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I found, is that by having another human being

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278
