metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I can do all the other work to build relationships, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: To have side conversations with people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: To sort out the right way to tell a story, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Or to transfer footage, knowing that the director of photography

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: is still filming during all that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So it frees me up to think of it as a director

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: rather than just an image acquirer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah, because there's also, I don't know how distracting it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: You've obviously done it for years, but setting stuff up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: it preoccupies your mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Like pressing the record button and framing stuff and all that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: that takes up some part of your mind where you can't think freely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That's my choice, right? That's how I work best.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That said, the caveat there would be,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: that's not the only way to do it, obviously, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: One of my favorite documentaries of all time

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: is a documentary called A Woman Captured, shot in Hungary,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: by a single filmmaker with a single camera with a single lens, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And it's brilliant and powerful and moving and interventional.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's incredible filmmaking, and it was a single human being

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: who created that film with a collaborator or a subject.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So it can be done, it's just not how I work best.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah. How much personally with the other person,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: how important is the relationship with them outside of the filming?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: With the director of photography?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: To the director of photography, say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: How much drinking, and if you don't drink,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: whatever the equivalent of that is, do you have to do together?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: How much soul searching, or is it more like two surgeons getting together?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Is it surgeons or is it a jazz band?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Well, it could be either, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Hopefully not at the same time though,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: because I don't think surgeons and jazz bands go well together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: They're both good with fingers, I suppose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Exactly, but I'd rather maybe not play jazz while they operate on me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But I think for me, I think there are moments of both,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: but usually not at the same time, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: There are surgical moments where the moment is so pressing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: you really have to be that task driven, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: To capture as thoroughly as possible whatever is unfolding, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But I think there's other times where you do improvise like jazz, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Where you have a lot of choices ahead of you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: and you're doing maybe a dance with the other camera person, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: In order to capture a scene as creatively and fully as possible during a fixed duration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: How much you said shaping, because it is non-fiction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: but I feel like there's so many ways to tell the same non-fiction

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: that it's bordering on fiction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's storytelling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And how much shaping do you see yourself as doing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: How important is your role in how you tell the story?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I suppose the question I'm asking is, how many ways can you really screw this up?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Every day you can screw it up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I mean, that's really the ethos of documentary filmmaking, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I allow a lot of things to guide my choices.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: One of them being, am I being fair, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Not balanced, but am I being fair to what I'm witnessing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Is the camera capturing in a fair way the truth of the reality?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And it also speaks to consent, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Am I being fair in a sense of, do I have active consent in this moment, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Regardless of whether I have a signed piece of paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I always find some way to document it, whether it's just direct address to camera

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: or a translated release.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So they say something to the camera that they consent or they sign the thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah, so for example, the large broadcast companies have this formalized process

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: where they present a piece of paper, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And the subject reads it and they sign it and then you have permission.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And that's irrevocable, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So it'll hold up in court.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That's not how I operate, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And so it's just, for example, that doesn't work if someone's illiterate

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: and can't read that piece of paper, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: What if they don't know how to sign their name, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So instead you have to have a conversation, ask questions, have them ask questions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: come to a complete understanding before you even know whether they understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: what you're asking, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And then in that case, if someone's illiterate, then you have that conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: You just sit down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It takes a long time sometimes, but you have to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And then if they still want to participate and they give you their consent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: they can't sign a piece of paper, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So then you just do in their native language, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: They give direct consent to camera in their language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But also you're speaking to the consent that's just a human placing trust in you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: You make a connection like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That's the most important consent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I hate papers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I hate papers and lawyers because they, exactly for that reason, yeah, okay, great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But you should be focusing on the human connection that leads to the trust,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: like real consent and consent day to day, minute to minute, because that can change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And it does change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: You mentioned a woman captured.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I'm sure you can't answer that, but I will force you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: What are the top three documentaries of all time, short or feature length?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: This is not your opinion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: This is objective truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: What's the top one? What's the greatest?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: We've got, let's see, March of the Penguins.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That's probably number one for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Really?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: No, I'm just kidding. I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I do seem to, the metaphor of penguins huddling together in hard, cold,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: like in the harsh conditions of nature, that's something that's kind of beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I don't love all nature documentaries, but like something about March of the Penguins,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I think Morgan Freeman narrates it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So maybe everything, just any documentary with Morgan Freeman, I'm a sucker for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Warner Herzog, Life and the Taiga, The Simple People.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I love Grizzly Man.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I love Grizzly Man. I think that's one of his best works, you know?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yes. I think that's Joe Rogan's favorite documentary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's both comedy and, I mean, it's...

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Tragic comedy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Tragic comedy, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Is there something that stands out to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I mean, I'm joking about like best, something that was impactful to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Just to put it out there, I don't think there's any way to say that they're objectively,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: you know, the best three documentaries of all time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But for me, and you may find this interesting, given your background,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: is that I think my top three are all from the Eastern Bloc, actually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So Aquarella by Kosciakowski, Victor Kosciakowski is one of my favorite.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's a couple years old now, which is sort of a meditation on the place water has on our planet and on our lives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I think A Woman Captured that I mentioned, which was shot in Hungary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Is it a feature length one?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Both are feature lengths, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It is just brilliant and it, I think, has yet to find distribution here in the US.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But it's the perfect example of what they call verite or direct nonfiction filmmaking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: A European woman, this is the synopsis,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: A European woman has been kept by a family as a domestic slave for 10 years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: drawing courage from the filmmaker's presence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: She decides to escape the unbearable oppression and become a free person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Wow. So the filmmaker is part of the story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Part of the story. It didn't start that way, but during the course of the story,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: the filmmaker comes to understand that this is actually modern-day slavery.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And rather than just allow it to be, actually enables and assists this woman to free herself from slavery and become a free woman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I wonder, sorry, on a small tangent before we get to number three, like Ikarus is interesting too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: How often do you become part of the story or the story is different because of your presence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Like you changed the tide of history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah. Well, back to just like one person at a time that we keep talking, you know, coming back to that theme on some level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So this could tie in interestingly to one of my favorite films, actually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So the last two films that I would mention from my top four list would be the third Eastern Bloc one would be a film called Immortal in 2019,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: which was shot in Russia by a Russian woman that sort of, you know, examines the place of the state in shaping individuals to be vehicles for the state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I mean, that's my own synopsis, but that's one of my takeaways from the brilliant 60 minute doc or so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Again, Russian filmmaking is really quite good and powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: The fourth one would be a Frederick Wiseman film, Titigat Follies, which was filmed in the US decades ago inside basically the bowels of an insane asylum or a mental health institution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And I bring up Wiseman because, you know, he is really the godfather, so to speak, of direct cinema or cinema verite.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And I went early in my career.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I really believed in what he expressed as the place of the verite filmmaker, which is simply fly on the wall, which is only observational nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Right. And I believe that that's how I should be as a nonfiction filmmaker, that I was there only to bear witness, to observe and not to intervene in any way, shape or form.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And that was the sort of foundation for how I operate for many, many years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And then some things happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So one of those things that happened was I film Lifeboat. And during the course of filming Lifeboat, which covered rescue operations in the Mediterranean off the coast of Libya,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: in the first three days of that rescue mission, we came upon over 3,000 people, asylum seekers, floating in flimsy rafts in the water.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And we were on the zodiacs and we were filming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And within the first couple hours, you know, we would come up to these rafts and these boats that were in really dire shape.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And people would be pushed off and people would jump off and people would fall into the water.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And some of them couldn't swim.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And so we found ourselves in this moment where we had a choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: We could film someone drown in front of us or we could put our cameras down and pull them out of the water.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And so that's what we did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: We put our cameras in the bottom of the zodiac and just started pulling people out of the water.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And, you know, if I was Wiseman, right, according to his paradigm, then we should have just filmed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And I didn't anticipate that moment beforehand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I had no sort of foreknowledge that I was going to find myself faced with that dilemma of the moment as a documentarian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But there was no question in my mind that I had to put my camera down and pull that fellow human being out of the water.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And I don't regret it at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So I've come to a different place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I've evolved to what I believe for the kind of film that I do is more appropriate, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Like I can go to sleep at night knowing that regardless of how the film would have been different, if I hadn't made that choice, I made the right choice as a human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So I think of it as being a human being first and a filmmaker second in moments like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That's beautifully, beautifully put.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But I also think like you could be a human being in small ways, too, like silly ways and put a little bit of yourself in documentaries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I tend to see that as really beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Like the meta piece of it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Like, yeah, just just put yourself into the into the movie a little bit because like break that third, fourth, whatever the wall is, is realized that there's a human behind the camera, too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: For some reason, me as a fan, as a viewer, that's enjoyable, too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I think there's a real authenticity there behind the straw, especially with these hard stories that you're doing that there's a human being struggling to like observing the suffering and having to bear the burden that this kind of suffering exists in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And you're behind that camera living that struggle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And there's small ways to show yourself in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: As you know, I don't do that in a big way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But, you know, I actually there are subtle moments where I allow that presence to live just for a second.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Like, like, I hate belly button docs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That's what I call them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: What's a belly button doc?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's navel gazing, right, where sort of a narcissistic filmmaking where someone just studies their own place in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Right. I think I see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah, I think my, you know, I'm more concerned with how I can intervene.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Right. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Well, you're trying to really deeply empathize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah. So like, if you do, my.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I don't want to center myself in these stories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's not about me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Right. I am so unimportant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: What is important is what's happening, what's unfolding in the world that we need to act upon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And I think it's selfish and narcissistic to push myself into these stories unnecessarily.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Now, that said, I think there is some small value in what you're saying just to remind viewers that there's obviously a filmmaker at play.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So sometimes the way that I do that is just like through a question on camera.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I'd allow the audio to live of a question or during a conversation I'm having with someone so they can they can just hear how it's posed, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Right. And to me, that's enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah, I do like moments when people recognize that you exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: They look at the filmmaker past the camera and that, yes, you ask the question in the interview or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And they respond to that. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Like they respond to this like new perturbation into their reality that was created by this other human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And I especially like when those questions or those perturbations are like a little bit absurd and like add something very novel to their situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And that novelty reveals something about them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So as opposed to capturing the day to day reality of their life, you do that plus the perturbations of like something novel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah. But of course, there's there's there's all kinds of ways to do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Let me. What was number five, by the way?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Only I only gave you four. You just stay at four.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: There's a short doc I like I mentioned they're called The Toxic Pigs of Fukushima.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I know. I know. I apologize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's dark. It's a great title though, right? It's a great title.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's it's no one's seen it, but it's great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's it says what it sounds like. Yeah. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's exactly what it sounds like, but really brilliantly executed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Well, let me ask you about Lifeboat, because it's extremely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I don't. It's a really moving idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Just just the fact that this exists in the world, that there's as a metaphor, as a reality, that there is a set of people trying to flee desperately is the desperation of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And now with his refugees, the desperation of that of of trying to escape towards a world that full of mystery, uncertainty,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: doubt could be hopeless at times, and you're willing to do a lot to free your own survival, the survival of your family and all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That's kind of the human spirit. And you just capture it in Lifeboat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Can you tell me the story behind this film as you started to already tell?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Can you tell me what is it about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So Lifeboat really seeks to sort of lift up and showcase the asylum seeker crisis in the Mediterranean when it was at its height in 2016.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And it came to be for many reasons. But one of those reasons is colleagues in the NGO community really shared with me that when the borders between Greece and Turkey were shut down,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: that the the flow of Syrian asylum seekers that was initially going across from Turkey to Greece was going to shift westward across the Mediterranean.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So I started to research that and discovered that was exactly the case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And then further stumbled upon the fact that nation states hadn't really stepped up to address it and that there were hundreds of asylum seekers often drowning in these flimsy crafts that were pushed off from the shores of Libya

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: because the EU wasn't doing its duty to patrol those waters from a humanitarian standpoint.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And so the net result of that was that this whole sort of humanitarian community sprung up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And it was civil society based that tried to meet the needs of those asylum seekers to just ensure that fellow human beings weren't drowning, simply put.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And one of those was this small little NGO called Sea Watch, which when they discovered what was happening just cobbled together a coalition of volunteers

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: bought a research vessel, retrofitted it and motored down off the coast of Libya to start pulling people out of the water.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And again, I found that inspiring. I found that inspiring that this group of volunteers was doing something that our leaders wouldn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And it was something as basic and simple as saving human beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And I thought there was an inspiring story there. And as it turned out, there was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Have you ever saved someone's life as part of making these documentaries directly?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And directly, I think you probably have countless lives, but directly, were you put in that position?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I don't want to. I mean, I certainly poured people out of the water who couldn't swim. I did that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And that's again speaking to the basic humanity. Put down the camera and help. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So this is people coming from Libya, trying to make it across the Mediterranean Sea on a crappy tiny boat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: From a filmmaker perspective, how do you film that? Was there decisions to capture the desperation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Well, we were going back to this idea of access and how that's so fundamental to my approach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: We were bound by the strictures of the rescue operation on this sea watch vessel, which was 30 meters long.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And we were two of a crew of 15. So we had to multitask all the time because the only reason we were on that boat

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: was by agreeing that if needed, we would do whatever necessary to help.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And so it was very active on multiple levels. And we were making decisions each and every day that were

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: not only filmmaking and creative decisions, but also decisions about how to live that duality, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Of being a humanitarian and a filmmaker simultaneously. And the greatest example I can share of that was

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: with my director of photography in that project, Kenny Allen. Kenny's a big guy. He's got arms like tree trunks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And because he was so physically able and strong, the head of mission really tasked him to be on the zodiacs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: to pull people out of the water because he could literally with one arm reach down and just oftentimes pull someone out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Whereas usually it would take two or three people. And so when we were at the height of triage and there were people

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: in the water all over and rafts were sinking, Kenny was out pulling people out of the water.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And this went on for like 24 hours. And at the end of that first day, I remember looking over on the deck

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: and seeing Kenny help people up from the ladders to walk them back. And his camera was nowhere to be seen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And so I walked over to him and I just grabbed him by the shoulders and said, Kenny, where's your camera?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And he didn't know. He had no idea where his camera was. And so I just said, Kenny, we're here to do what you're doing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: but we're also here to film it, right? To make sure that we document what is unfolding in front of us

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: so that we have a record of it, right? So we can bring it to a larger audience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So you need to go find your camera so we can also document it. And that kind of pulled him out and he went and got his camera

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: and started filming again. But that gives you a sense of sort of this world that we had to live in, in order to get the story done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But I think to be a great director of photography, to be a great director, you have to lose yourself like that in the story too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But usually with a camera in your hand, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But sometimes you forget the camera. I mean, there's a, I feel like if you're obsessed with the camera too much,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: you can lose the humanity of it. You get obsessed with the film and the story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It can become clinical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yes, it can become clinical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Absolutely. And it's, you know, yeah, absolutely. And we don't want to become, I don't want to become clinical in my film, certainly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Let me ask you a strange and perhaps edgy question. So some filmmakers believe it's justified to break the rules in order to tell a powerful story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Warner Herzog, I read this somewhere, teaches young filmmakers to pick locks and forge documents and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I didn't know that. Interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: What do you think about that? Bending the rules in service of telling a story?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: You would of course never break the law. But is there, does that just generally speaking, bending the rules and so on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: You know, just to elaborate on this question, perhaps I'm distinctly aware that there's parts in the world where the rule of law is not like enforced

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: as cleanly as it is in the United States, as fairly as it is in the United States, that there's a kind of, there's a lot of bribery.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: There's a lot of, like you don't really know to trust, you can, you don't know if you can trust the cops or basically anybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So like the rules are very hazy kind of concept. And a lot of them, especially like, it's funny, but authoritarian regimes often have a giant bureaucracy build up that's full of rules.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: There's more rules than you know what to deal with. And you can't actually live life unless you break the rules.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Anyway, laying that all out on the table, do you ever contend with that on what are the rules I can break or should break to keep to the spirit of the story?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I think you have to ask yourself, are the rules just and why are they in place? Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So for example, coming into the airport in southern Yemen, right? If I just tried to walk through the airport with all my equipment, even with all the permissions beforehand, like we had,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: without having a fixer at the airport beforehand to make sure we didn't go through the standard line, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: We would have been caught up for three hours at least negotiating over our equipment and eventually paying a bribe to get it through.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That's just reality in a place like Yemen. And so of course, knowing that, having talked to colleagues who had taken that path previously, I took a different path.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Well, we hire a fixer beforehand to sort it out beforehand, right? Rather than spending three hours of our time and paying a series of bribes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Instead, we're going to get it fixed beforehand so that we can walk through a different line and have no one look at any of our equipment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That's a pretty good trade-off in my mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: What about security when you're traveling in these places? Do you ever have bodyguards?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Well, several questions around that. Are you ever afraid for your life when you're filming in a war zone?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Is there any way to lessen the probability of death?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I don't have a death wish. I try to mitigate risk however I can, however I can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But one of the ways I can't do it in a conflict zone is by having armed security with me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And the reason for that is because, especially in a place like Yemen, if you have armed security, you become a target in a way that if you're operating under the auspices of international humanitarian law, I actually have more protection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So I don't bring security. If you're working in northern Yemen, for example, you're going to have someone from the de facto authorities with you anyway the entire time you're there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So the authorities are with you in form anyway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Regarding fear? Yeah, of course. I mean, fear is a natural human emotion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And I think we have a weird mindset, this sort of heroic mindset surrounding fear in the US, which I don't pay tribute to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I believe as a natural human emotion, it's an alarm bell that I need to pay attention to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And I think rather than pretending to be brave, I think you have to just acknowledge that fear has a place to keep you alive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And I think it's a matter of not letting the fear arrest you and allowing the fear to live and then acting anyway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Don't you think as a documentary filmmaker, the fear is a really good signal for potentially a good thing to do because there's a story there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So is fear an indicator that you shouldn't do it or is it an indicator that you should do it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: It's probably an indication you should do it, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And strangely, I think that's why, if there's something unusual about the work I do in some part, it's because of these types of stories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: They're hard to access, but you also have to have a threshold of willingness to do them when you can't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: There is no guarantee of physical safety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And maybe that's why you should do them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I'm very much motivated by the things that scare me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: They seem to direct the things that are worth doing in this all too short life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: How often do you interact with our friendly friends at the police departments of various locations?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Because of the humanitarian nature of your work, are you able to avoid all such friendly conversations or are you often making friends with our...

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I try to avoid the friendly police people all over the world as much as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But in some instances, it's important to be proactive and make sure that they know what you're doing before you do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So it's all about the context and the situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: For example, working in Northern Yemen, you couldn't film for five minutes if you didn't have paperwork because you'd be taken away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So you have to make sure you have all those permissions ahead of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: 50 Feet from Syria. I would love to talk at least a little bit about this film.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: First, can you, high level, can you tell what this documentary is about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah, it was early in the Syrian uprising and we returned to the Syrian Turkish border with a Syrian American orthopedic surgeon who was volunteering,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: operating on refugees as they flowed across the border from Syria into Turkey.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And it was an attempt at the time, before a lot of films had come out about the conflict, to really show again the effects of the war on civilians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: You've heard me echo that sentiment multiple times now, but people knew there was a major conflict in Syria,

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: but didn't really understand the form that that was taking and the impact it was having.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And so we embedded into the, at the time it was the only clinic in Turkey that was sanctioned by the Turkish government to treat Syrian refugees.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And so we filmed there with surgeons as they operated on war victims.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And we also went into Syria into some of the camps as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So in this film, there's a man who crosses the border every day to retrieve the wounded and fair them safety and care.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And you also mentioned about heroism in the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Can you tell me about this man and just people like him?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Like, what's the heroic action in some of these places that you've visited?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So in that instance, you know, I thought of him as the Turkish Schindler, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Because he was a human being who of his own volition, no one was paying him to do this, but he was spending much of his time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: He was just a local businessman who really saw the need in the camps right across the border, 10k away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And he saw the medical need in particular and how hard it was to get people in desperate medical conditions

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: across the border where there was a clinic just right across the border.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But because of the security and the layers of security, they couldn't get out by themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: So he took it upon himself as a Turkish person to build relationships with the Turkish guards, which was relatively easy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And then he built relationships with sort of the guards in the no man's land between the Syrian guards and sort of those who lived in the middle area.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And then also with the Syrian guards at the camp, and he would drive out there daily and bring them food, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Talk them up and build relationships.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And so every day he would bring these guards food and build relationships with them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And what that meant was eventually, right, he had this avenue of access to and from the camps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And so he started using it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And he would drive this avenue of access through the three layers of guards each day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And then they would open the gates for him because he had made himself trustworthy in their eyes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And he would receive the most desperate medical cases that were coming from all over northern Syria, right, to receive medical treatment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And he would, as you see in the film, he would ferry them into the back of his car, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And then drive them to the hospital where they would receive operations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And then he would bring them back if they wanted after they'd healed and recovered back to Syria, if they wanted to return post recovery.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And, you know, he didn't get paid for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: He was spending his own money to do it because he saw other human beings in need.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And it's like we were talking about earlier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That's heroic, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That's selfless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: That's aspirational for me, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Here's someone who is spending their time on the planet doing something of value and good to other human beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I mean, if you draw parallels to Schindler, I feel like the fascinating thing about Schindler is that he's kind of a flawed human and is not the kind of human that does these things usually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: But you just can't help it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And that's like the basic humanity despite who you are, the basic humanity shines through.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: I think that, you know, the whims of war test people in those ways, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: They ask of you things that you may not even know were going to be asked of you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: And then it speaks to who you are fundamentally as a human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

body.input: If you pay some money, you can watch some of the great films ever made.

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278

metadata.title: Podcast: Skye Fitzgerald: Hunger, War, and Human Suffering | Lex Fridman Podcast #278
