metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: That's the ordinary way that arm is trying to work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And there it turns out that humans and chimpanzees

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: are in a very similar kind of state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: That is to say, if you look at the rate of death

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: from chimpanzees conducting proactive

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: coalition violence, it's very similar in many ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to what you see in humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So we're not downregulated with proactive violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It's just this reactive violence

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that is strikingly reduced in humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So chimpanzees also practiced kind of tribal warfare.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Indeed they do, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So this was discovered first in 1974.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It was observed first in 1974,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: which was about the time that the first major study of

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: chimpanzees in the wild by Jane Goodall

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: had been going for something like five years

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: during of the chimpanzees being observed

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: wherever they went.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Until then, they'd been observed at a feeding station

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: where Jane was luring them in to be observed

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: by seeing bananas, which is great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: She learned a lot, but she didn't learn what was happening

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: at the edges of their ranges.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So five years later, it became very obvious

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that there was hostile relationships between groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And those hostile relationships sometimes take the form

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of the kind of hostile relationships

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that you see in many animals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: which is a bunch of chimps in this case,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: shouting at a bunch of other chimps on their borders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But dramatically, in addition to that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: there is a second kind of interaction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And that is when a party of chimpanzees

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: makes a deliberate venture to the edge of their territory

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: silently and then search for members of neighboring groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And what they're searching for is a lone individual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So I've been with chimps when they've heard

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: a lone individual under these circumstances

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: or what they think is a lone one,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and they touch each other and look at each other

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and then charge forward, very excited.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And then while they're charging,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: all of a sudden the place where they heard a lone call

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: erupts with a volley of calls.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It was just one calling out of a larger party.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And our chimps put on the brakes

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and scoot back for safety into their own territory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But if in fact they do find a lone individual

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and they can sneak up to them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: then they make a deliberate attack.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: They're hunting, they're stalking and hunting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and then they impose terrible damage,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: which typically ends in a kill straight away,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: but it might end up with the victim so damaged

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that they'll crawl away and die a few days or hours later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So that was a very dramatic discovery

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because it really made people realize for the first time

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that Conrad Lorenz had been wrong when in the 1960s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in his famous book, On Aggression,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: he said warfare is restricted to humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: animals do not deliberately kill each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, now we know that actually there's a bunch of animals

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that deliberately kill each other,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and they always do so under essentially

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: the same circumstances, which is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: when they feel safe doing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So humans feel safe doing it when they've got a weapon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Animals feel safe when they have a coalition,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: a coalition that has overwhelming power

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: compared to the victim.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so wolves will do that, and lions will do that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and hyenas will do that, and chimpanzees will do it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and humans do it too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Can they pull themselves into something

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that looks more like a symmetric war

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: as opposed to an asymmetric one?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So accidentally engaging on the lone individual

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and getting themselves into trouble?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Or are they more aggressive

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in avoiding these kinds of battles?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: No, they're very, very keen to avoid those kinds of battles,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: but occasionally they can make a mistake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But so far there have been no observations

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of anything like a battle

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in which both sides maintain themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And I think you can very confidently say

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that overwhelmingly what happens is that if they discover

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that there's several individuals on the other side,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: then both sides retreat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Nobody wants to get hurt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: What they want to do is to hurt others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yes, so you mentioned Jane Goodall.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: You've worked with her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: What was it like working with her?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: What have you learned from her?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, she's a wonderfully independent, courageous person,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: you know, who she famously began her studies

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: not as a qualified person in terms of education,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: but qualified only by enthusiasm

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and considerable experience even in her early 20s with nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So she's courageous in the sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of being able to take on challenges.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: The thing that is very impressive about her

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: is her total fidelity to the observations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: very unwilling to extend beyond the observations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: you know, waiting until they mount up

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and you've really got a confident picture

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and tremendous attention to individuals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, you know, that was an interesting problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: from her point of view,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because when she got to know the chimpanzees of Gombe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: this particular community of Cazacayla,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: about 60 individuals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: so Gombe was in Tanzania on Lake Tanganyika.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: She was there initially with her mother

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and then alone for two or three years

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of really intense observation

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and then slowly joined by other people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: What she discovered was that there were obvious differences

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in individual personality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And the difficulty about that was that

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: when she reported this to the larger scientific world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: initially her advisors at Cambridge,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: they said, well, you know, we don't know how to handle that

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because you've got to treat all these animals

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: as the same basically,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because there is no research tradition

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of thinking about personalities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, now, whatever it is, 60 years later,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: the study of personalities is a very rich part

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of the study of animal behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: At any rate, the important point in terms of

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: what was she like is that she stuck to her guns

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and she absolutely insisted that we have to show,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: describe in great detail the differences in personality

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: among these individuals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and then you can leave it to the evolutionary biologists

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to think about what it means.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So what is the process of observation like this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: like observing the personality,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: but also observing in a way that's not projecting

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: your beliefs about human nature or animal nature

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: onto chimps, which is probably really tempting to project.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So your understanding of the way the human world works,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: projecting that onto the chimp world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yes, I mean, it's particularly difficult with chimps

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because chimps are so similar to humans in their behavior

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that it's very easy to make those projections.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: As you say, the process involves making very clear

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: definitions of what a behavior is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Aggression can be defined in terms of a forceful hit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: a bite and so on, and writing down every time

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: these things happen, and then slowly totting up

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: the numbers of times that they happen from individual A

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: towards individuals B, C, D, and E, so that you build up

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: a very concrete picture rather than interpreting

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: at any point and stopping and saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: well, they seem to be rather aggressive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So the formal system is that you build up a pattern

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of the relationships based on a description

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of the different types of interactions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: the aggressive and the friendly interactions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and all of these are defined in concrete.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so from that, you extract a pattern of relationships.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And the relationships can be defined as relatively friendly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: relatively aggressive, competitive, based on the frequency

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of these types of interactions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so one can talk in terms of individuals

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: having a relationship which on the scores of friendliness

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: is two standard deviations outside the mean.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, it's-

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: We're in which direction, sorry, both directions?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, I mean, there'll be obviously the friendly ones

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: would be the ones who have exceptionally high rates

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of spending time close to each other,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of touching each other in a gentle way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of grooming each other, and by the way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: finding that those things are correlated with each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So it's possible to define a friendship with a capital F

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in a very systematic way and to compare that

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: between individuals, but also between communities

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of chimpanzees and between different species.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So that we can say that in some species,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: individuals have friends and others they don't at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: What about just because there's different personalities

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and because they're so fascinating,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: what about sort of falling in love

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: or forming friendships with chimps?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Like really connecting with them as an observer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: What role does that play?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Because you're tracking these individuals

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that are full of life and intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: for long periods of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Plus as a human, especially in those days for Jane,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: she's alone observing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It gets lonely as a human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, probably deeply lonely as a human being observed

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: these other intelligent species.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It's a very reasonable question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And of course, Jane in those early years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I think she's willing now to talk about the fact

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that she regrets to some extent how close she became.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And the problem is not just from the humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: the problem is from the chimpanzees as well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because they do things that are extremely affectionate

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: if you like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: At one point, Jane offered a ripe fruit

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to a chimpanzee called David Greybeard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: David Greybeard took it and squeezed her hand

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: as if to say thank you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And then I think he gave it back if I remember rightly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: No, thank you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Oh, it's almost like thank you

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and returning the affection by giving the fruit

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: if they did something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It was a gentle squeeze.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, chimpanzees could squeeze you very hard

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: as occasionally has happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Some chimps are aggressive to people

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and others are friendly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And the ones that are friendly tend to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: rather sympathetic characters because they might be ones

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: who are having problems in their own society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, Jomeo in Gombe used to come and sit next to me

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: quite often and he was having a hard time making it

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in that society, which I can describe to you

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in terms of the number of aggressive interactions

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: if you want, but just to be informed about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, all of this is a temptation to be very firmly resisted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And in the community that I've been working with in Uganda

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: for the last 30 years, we try extremely hard to impress

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: on all of the research students who come with us

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that it is absolutely vital

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that you do not fall into that temptation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Now, we heard a story of one person who did reach out

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and touch one of our chimps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It's a very, very bad idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Not because the chimp is going to do anything violent

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: at the time, but because if they learn

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that humans are as weak physically as we are

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: compared to them, then they can take advantage of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And that's what happened in Gombe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, after Jane had done the very obvious thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: when you're first engaged in this game

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of allowing the infants to approach her

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and then tickling them and playing with them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: some of those infants had the personality

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of wanting to take advantage of that knowledge later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so, you had an individual, Frodo,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: who was violent on a regular basis towards humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: when he was an adult, and he was quite dangerous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, he could easily have killed someone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: In fact, he did kill one person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: He killed a baby that he took from a mother,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: a human baby, that he took off her hip

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: when he met her on the path.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, it's a reminder that we're dealing with a species

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that are rather human-like in the range of emotions

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: they have, in the capacities they have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and even in the strength they have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: they are in many ways stronger than humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, you've got to be careful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, in the full range of friendliness and violence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: the capacity for these very human things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yes, I mean, it's very obvious with violence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: as we talked about, that they will kill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: They will kill not just strangers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: They can kill other adults within their own group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: They can kill babies that are strangers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: They can kill babies in their own group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, this is a long-lived individual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Obviously, these killings can't have very often,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because otherwise, they'd all be dead.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And we're now finding that they can live to 50 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: They can live to 50 or 60 years in the wild

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: at relatively low population density,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because they're big animals eating a rather specialized

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: kind of food, the ripe fruits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, it doesn't happen all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: With friendliness, they are very strong

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to support each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: They very much depend on their close friendships,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: which they express through physical contact,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and particularly through grooming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, grooming occurs when one individual approaches another,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and might present for grooming,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: a very common way of starting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: turning their back or presenting an arm

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: or something like that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and the other just ripples their fingers through the hair.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And that's partly just soothing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and it's partly looking for parasites,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: but mostly it's just soothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And the point about this is it can go on for half an hour.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It can go on for sometimes even an hour.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, this is a major expression of interest

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in somebody else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: When did your interest in this one particular aspects

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of chim come to be, which is violence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: When did the study of violence in chimps

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: become something you're deeply interested in?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, for my PhD in the early 1970s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I was in Gombe with Jane Goodall

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and was studying feeding behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But during that time, we were seeing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and I say we because there were half a dozen research students

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: all in her camp,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: we were discovering that chimps had this capacity for violence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: the first kill happened during that time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: which was of an infant in a neighboring group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And we were starting to see these hunting expeditions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And this was the start of my interest

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because it was such chilling evidence

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of an extraordinary similarity between chimps and humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Now, at that time, we didn't know very much

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: about how chimpanzees and humans were related.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Chimps, gorillas, bonobos are all three big black hairy things

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that live in the African forests and eat fruits

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and leaves when they can't find fruits

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and walk on their knuckles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And they all look rather similar to each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So they seem as though those three species,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: chimps and gorillas and bonobos,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: should all be each other's closest relatives

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and humans should be their closest relatives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Humans are something rather separate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so any of them would be of interest to us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Subsequently, we learn that actually that's not true

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and that there's a special relationship

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: between humans and chimpanzees.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But at the time, even without knowing that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: it was obvious that there was something very odd

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: about chimpanzees because Jane had discovered

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: they were making tools.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: She had seen that they were hunting meat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: She had seen that they were sharing the meat

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: among each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: She had seen that the societies were dominated politically

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: by males, coalitions of males.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: All of these things of course resonate

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: so closely with humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And then it turns out that in contrast

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to conventional wisdom at the time,
