metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in the sense that what we don't have is an alpha male

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: who personally beats up every other male.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And the answer that has been portrayed most richly

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: by Christopher Bohm and whose work I've elaborated on

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: is that only in humans, do you have a system

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: by which any male who tries to bully others

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and become the alpha equivalent to an alpha gorilla

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: or an alpha chimpanzee or an alpha bonobo

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: or an alpha baboon or anything like that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: any male who tries to do that in humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: gets taken down by a coalition of beta males.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: That coalition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: That's a really good picture of human society, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I like it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, and that's the way all our societies work now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Because individuals try and be alpha

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and then they get taken out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yeah, I mean, we don't usually think of ourselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: as beta males, but yes, I suppose that's what democracy is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It's a very, very, very, very, very, very, very, very,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Okay, so at some point alpha males get taken out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, what alpha males are, are males who respond

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: with high reactive violence

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to any challenge to their status.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: You see it all the time in primates.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Some beta male thinks he's getting strong

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and maturing in wisdom and so on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and he refuses to kowtow to the alpha male.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And the alpha male comes straight in and charges at him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Or maybe he'll just wait for a few minutes

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and then take an opportunity to attack him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: All of these primates have got a high tendency

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: for reactive aggression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And that enables this possibility alpha males.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: We don't, we have this great reduction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: as I talked about earlier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And the question is, when did that reduction happen?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, cut to the famous experiments

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: by the Russian biologist Dmitry Believ,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: who tried domesticating wild animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: When you domesticate wild animals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: what you're doing is reducing reactive aggression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: You are selecting those individuals to breed

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: who are most willing to be approached by a human

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: or by another member of their own species

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and are least likely to erupt in a reactive aggression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And you only have to do that for a few generations

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to discover that there are changes in the skull.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And those changes consist of shorter face, smaller teeth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: reduced maleness, the males become increasingly female-like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and reduced brain size.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, the changes that are characteristic

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of domesticated animals in general,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: compared to wild animals, are all found in homo sapiens

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: compared to our early ancestors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So it's a very strong signal that when we first see

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: homo sapiens, what we're seeing is that the brain size

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: is very small compared to the males.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And that's a very strong signal that when we first see

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: homo sapiens, what we're seeing is evidence of a reduction

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in reactive aggression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And that suggests that what's happening with homo sapiens

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: is that that is the point at which there is selection

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: against the alpha males.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And therefore, the way in which the selection happened

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: would have been the way it happens today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And that's why we're so surprised by the suppression

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of reactive aggression as a kind of incidental consequence

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of the suppression of the alpha male.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And the story of our species is the story of how

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: the beta males took charge and have been responsible

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: for the generation of a new kind of human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Incidentally, for imposing on the society

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: a new set of values.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Because when those beta males discovered that they could

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: take out the previous alpha male and continue to do so,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because in every generation, there'll always be some male

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: who says, maybe I'll become the alpha male.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so they just keep chopping them down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: In discovering that, they also obviously discovered

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that they could kill anybody in the group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Females, young males, anybody who didn't follow their values.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so this story is one in which the males of our species,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and these would be the breeding males,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: have been able to impose their values on everybody else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And there is two kind of values.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: There's one kind of value is things that are good

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: for the group, like thou shalt not murder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And the other kind of value is things that are good

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: for the males, such as, hey, guess what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: When good food comes in, males get it first.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, it's fascinating that that kind of set of ideals

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: could outcompete the others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Do you have a sense of why, or maybe you can comment

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: on Neanderthals and all the other early humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: why did homo sapiens come to succeed and flourish

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and all the other ones, all the other branches

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of evolution died out or get murdered out?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Nowadays, when homo sapiens meets homo sapiens,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and we don't know each other initially,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: then conflict breaks out and the more militarily able group

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: wins, we've seen that everywhere throughout the age

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of exploration and throughout history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So I'm rather surprised, the conventional wisdom

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that you see nowadays in contemporary anthropology

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: is very reluctant to point to success in warfare

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: as the reason why sapiens wiped out Neanderthals

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: within about 3000 years of the sapiens coming into Europe

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: 43,000 years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And people are much more inclined to say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: well, the Neanderthals were at low population density,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: so they just couldn't survive the demographic sweep

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: or that the disease came in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And maybe those things might've been important,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: but far and away, the most obvious possibility

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: is that sapiens were just powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Everyone agrees they had larger groups,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: they had better weapons, they had projectile weapons,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: bows and arrows to judge from the little microlyth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: bits of flake, which the Neanderthals didn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Nowadays, there's evidence of interbreeding,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: quite extensive interbreeding between sapiens

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and Neanderthals, as well as with some other groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And sometimes people say, well, so they loved each other,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: they made love, not war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I think they made love and war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It wouldn't necessarily have been too loving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, if you just follow through

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: from typical ethnographies nowadays

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of when dominant groups meets subordinate groups,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: they didn't know each other,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: then you can imagine that Neanderthal females

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: would essentially be captured

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and taken into sapiens groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Maybe you can comment on this cautiously and eloquently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: What's the role of sexual violence in human evolution?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Because you mentioned taking Neanderthal females,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: you've also mentioned that some of these rules

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: are defined by the male side of the society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: What's the role of sexual violence in this story?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I think you've got to distinguish

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: between groups and within groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And I think the world has been slowly waking up

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: over the last several decades

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to the fact that sexual violence is routine in war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And that to me says that it's just another example

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of power corrupts because when frustrated, scared,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: elated soldiers come upon females in a group

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that there's been essential dehumanization of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: then they get carried away by opportunity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It is not always possible to argue

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that this is adaptive nowadays

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because you get lots and lots of stories

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: of women being abused to the point of being killed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: She'll be gang raped and then killed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: There's lots of terrible cases of that reported

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: from all sorts of different wars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But you can see that that could build on a pattern

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that would have been adaptive

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: if happening under so much less extreme circumstances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: The war is very extreme nowadays

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in the sense that you get battles

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in which people are sent by a military hierarchy

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: into a war situation in which they do not feel

body.input: what hunters and gathers would typically have felt,

body.input: Well, what do you mean by conflict?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, you can have conflict in the sense of

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: people have different ideas about the solution to a problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so their ideas are in conflict.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: They can sit down on a log and chat about it

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and then decide, okay, you're right,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: or I'm wrong or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But if by conflict, you mean a great idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to build a nuclear bomb and set that off,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: then no, I don't see why it's a good idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to have all this violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yeah, there's, I wonder, I mean, it's not a good idea,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: but I wonder if human history would evolve

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: the way it did without the violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Oh, I'm sure you're right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Probably humans would not have evolved

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in the sense that we have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But I would hope that the course of violence in evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: will continue in the way it has.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, there's all sorts of indications

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that the importance of violence has been reduced over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And this is made famous in Steven Pinker's book,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: but others have written about it too,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that the frequency of death from violence

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in every country you look at,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: has been declining.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: That's just great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so, the amazing thing about this

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: is that even when you take the death

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: due to the First World War and the Second World War,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: the 20th century appears to have been statistically,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: meaning rates of death per individual,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: the least violent in history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, we haven't got very far down the course to non-violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But I don't see why we shouldn't just carry on doing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I think it's ridiculous, frankly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: excuse my frankness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to say that violence is a good thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I think that it would be a wonderful concept

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: if we could evolve somehow to a world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: 3,000 years from now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: where violence is really regarded as simply appalling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And that they look back on our time

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and can't believe what we've done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And can't believe what we were doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yeah, but of course, violence takes a lot of different shapes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: As we start to think deeper and deeper

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: about living beings on Earth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: for example, the violence we commit

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and the torture we commit to animals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and then perhaps on the line,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: as we talked offline about with robots,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and that kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, there's just so many ways to commit violence to others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And some people now talk about violence

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in the space of ideas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: which of course, to me at least,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: is a bit of a silly notion relative to use that same V word

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: for the space of ideas versus actual physical violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But it may be that a long time from now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: we see that even violence in the space of ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: is quite a manifestation of that same kind of violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so, it is interesting where this is headed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And I think you're absolutely right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: A world, a nonviolent world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: does seem like a better world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I wonder if the constraints on resources

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: somehow make that world more and more difficult,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: especially as we run out of resources.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, it's got to be very, very different

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: from what we're doing nowadays.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And it's unimaginably different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: If we could imagine it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: then maybe we could work towards it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: At the moment, nobody knows how to work towards it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, that's kind of the stories of humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: is we don't really know the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: We're trying to ad hoc kind of develop it as we go

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and sometimes get into trouble as to violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But George Orwell's vision in 1984

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: was of two or three world powers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: each so powerful that nobody could diminish the,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: could destroy the other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But the notion of an evolutionarily stable relationship

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: among heavily armed world powers

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: just does not seem as though it's reasonable at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: That is to say, we've now got 170 or 190 nations in the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: dominated by a few big ones,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: all with arms pointing at each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And the notion that we could just carry on having peace talks

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and making sure that these arms don't get involved

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: in some kind of massive conflagration

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: seems incredibly optimistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Some kind of major change has to happen,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: whereby, you know, and some people wouldn't like to see

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: all the weapons go, that'd be great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: You know, I'm a member of that sort of group

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that tries to see that happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It's going to be very difficult to see it happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Another kind of concept is the nations themselves will dissolve

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and will become one government.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: That itself is a terrifying vision,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because the capacity for abuse by a single world power

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: would be so problematic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And in addition, how do you get there

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: without a war in the first place?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So, you know, at the moment we have no reasonable kind of future in mind,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: but I'm sure it's there somewhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It's just that we haven't yet to find it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And a lot of people, like in the cryptocurrency space,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: argue that you can create decentralized societies

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: if you take away the power from states to define the monetary system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So they argue, like, if you give, if you make the monetary system

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: such that it's disjoint from the control of any one individual,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: any one government, then that might be a way to form

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: sort of ad hoc decentralized societies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: They just pop up all over the place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: That's a really interesting technological solution

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to how to remove the overreach of power from governments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yes, right, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And it may well be that the future will emerge

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: out of some sort of quite surprising direction like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Is it nevertheless surprising to you

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that we have not destroyed ourselves with nuclear weapons,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: so the mutually assured destruction that we've had for many decades

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: from somebody who studies violence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: how does that make sense to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, I mean, I'm surprised only in the sense that

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: accidental, the fact that we have not had an accident yet

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: has been quite remarkable, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because all the accounts are that we've come very close

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to having very serious accidents where people on either side

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: have misread intentions or apparent launches and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So yes, I think it is remarkable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: There is a nasty generalization that can be made that

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: the longer that powerful states go without having wars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: then the worse the war is afterwards.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And you can sort of see that that kind of makes sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because basically what's happening with these tribal groups

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that the nations are at the moment is that after a big war,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: like the Second World War,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: they established new kinds of dominance relationships.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And then during the periods of peace,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: what happens is that the de facto dominance relationships change

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because some nations become poorer, some become richer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: some become more militarily powerful and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Generally, economy and military goes hand in hand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So right now China emerged from the war as a relatively low status state

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and is now high status.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So if these were chimpanzees, what would happen is that you would predict a conflict

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because you need to have a readjustment of the formal dominance relationships

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: to recognize the new in practice dominance relationships

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: recognized by the economy and the military.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So the longer that you have of a period of peace following a war,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: then the more these tensions of unresolved changed dominance relationships build up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And the longer they take to occur,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: then the more challenging are going to be the conflicts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: That's a terrifying view because we've been out of conflict for quite a bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Maybe it's building up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So it's a scary view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But on the other hand, things have changed usually with the advent of nuclear weapons

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: because at least that conforms to this psychology that is very clear in other animals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: which is you don't want to get into a fight if you are going to get hurt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So that's the whole principle of MAD, mutual issue of destruction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And it's doubtless been why powerful nations like America and Russia

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: have not used their nuclear weapons since 1945.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So if we can overcome the problem of accidental launches,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: then maybe the fact of MAD does fit into human psychology in a way

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that means that we really will resolve our tensions without using them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But we haven't yet really faced that challenge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, the Soviet Union collapsed because of the poor economy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: but with China desperate to take back Taiwan

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and America shifting its focus on the Pacific,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: the potential for something going wrong is clearly very high.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So what's the hopeful case that you can make for a long-term surviving

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and thriving human civilization given all the dangers that we face?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, I can't really exactly make one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I would just say that...

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: We're talking about the dangers. Obviously, the dangers are there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But what I would sort of think about is the notion that surprises come

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: from all sorts of different directions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, you work in robotics, and I can well imagine that there will be

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: advances in robotics that in some way I can't even conceive will somehow

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: undermine the motivation for conflict.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Something about by the time chips have been planted in human brains

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and we're all instantly sharing information in a way that we never did before,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: will this change the nature of human existence in such a way that these conflicts get resolved?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So remove the conflicts, but keep some of the magic, the beauty of what it means to be human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So still be able to enjoy life, the richness of life, the full complexity of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Because you can remove conflict by giving everybody a pill, then they go to sleep.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: You still want life to be amazing, exciting, interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so that's where you have to find the balance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, it's all science fiction stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so how it's going to work out, totally unclear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I don't see any worry about the magic of life disappearing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, first of all, you somehow get rid of males.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I think you really need to get rid of males because males are the source of a major problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: which is the lust for power and the resulting conflict.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But you don't think the males are also a source of beauty and creation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: No, no, I mean, I don't have anything against males as individuals and that sort of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And males have clearly done a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, they've been incredibly exploratory and creative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And what they've done in art and music has been wonderful and that sort of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: On the other hand, I'm not sure there's anything particularly special.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And I think that probably females could do the same thing just as well when given the chance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yes, including the dark stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, part of me is not understanding the...

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So there is evolutionary distinction between men and women,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: but I tend to believe both men and women, if you look out into the future, can be destructive,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: can be evil, can be greedy, can be corrupted by power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So if you move males from the picture, which are historically connected to this evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that we've been talking about, that women are going to fill that role quite nicely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And then it'll be just the same kind of process, not the same, but it'll be new and interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: There's a sense that the will to power, craving power, committing violence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: is somehow coupled with all the things that are beautiful about life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: That if you remove conflict completely, if you remove all the evil in the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: it seems like you're not going to have a stable place for the beauty, for the goodness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: There always has to be a dragon to fight for the way...

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: If you look at human history, now you can say...

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: The reason I'm nervous about a sort of utopia where everything is great

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: is every time you look through human history when utopia has been chased,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: you run into a lot of trouble or again, sneaks into this evil, this craving for power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Now you can say that's a male problem, but I just think it's a human problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And it's not even a human problem, it's a chimp problem too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It's life on earth problem, intelligent life on earth problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So it's better to not necessarily get rid of the sources of the darker sides of human nature,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: but more create mechanisms that the kindness, the goodness as...

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: The goodness paradox, your book, that that is incentivized and encouraged, empowered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, look, I don't think it would be utopia if you got rid of the males.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And certainly females are capable of conflict.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I just think it's a gamble worth taking if you could actually do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: You can certainly find females in history who've done unpleasant things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But nevertheless, we have a very strong evolutionary theory which explains why

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: males benefit more by having conflict and winning conflicts than females do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so if we want to talk about reducing conflict, then it would reduce it to get rid of males.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Now I understand this is a fantasy and I think it's a fantasy that people would be able to talk about

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: fairly soon because reproductive technology is getting to the point where it's quite likely

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: that human females could breed without the use of males.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And so there would be a sort of a potential dynamic if everybody just agreed not to have any male babies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It's a really interesting thought experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I will agree with you that if given two buttons, one is get rid of all women and the other button is get rid of all men.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Realizing that I have a stake in this choice, you're probably getting rid of all men.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: If I wanted to preserve Earth and the richness of life on Earth, I would probably get rid of all men.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I don't think you have a stake in it. You're saying that because you're a man.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But I don't see why being a man should make you any more interested in having a male future for the world than a female future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: You've got just as many ancestors who were male as were female.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, my problem is I'll have to die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Well, that's going to happen anyway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I prefer to die tomorrow, not today. I prefer to hit the snooze button and the whole mortality thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But this is not suggesting that males have to die in order to make room for females.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: All you have to do is just say, don't let's have any more males born.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Of course, the difficulty is that because we're tribal, some country somewhere would say, well, we're not going to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And then guess what? They'd take over because they're male.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: So that's why it's impossible to imagine actually happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: You know what? I'm going to take that and actually think about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I don't know. I'm uncomfortable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: There's a certain kind of woke culture that I've been kind of uncomfortable with because it's not women necessarily.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It's more just there's a lot of bullying I see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: There's a lack of empathy and a lack of kindness towards others that's created by that culture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But you're speaking about something else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: You're speaking about reducing conflict in this world and looking at the basics of our human nature and its origins in the evolution of homo sapiens

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: and thinking about which kind of aspects of human nature, if we get rid of them, will make for a better world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: It's an interesting thought experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But it is only a thought experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, it's got no practical meaning right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And I take your point that males get a hard rap nowadays in some ways because the balance of social power is moving against,

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I mean, quite rightly and in a strong sense, of course, against all the nasty things that males do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But what people sometimes fail to remember is that life is very hard for males who don't have the power, who don't have money, who don't have access to women.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: You know, I'm sympathetic to incels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: I'm not sympathetic to them using violence to solve their problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: But I am very sympathetic to the fact that it's not easy simply to be told by well-off, feminist, middle-class people that you shouldn't behave like this or you shouldn't feel like this because you do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: That's who you are. I mean, in general, just empathy and kindness, male or female, I believe, will be the thing that builds a better world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229

body.input: And that's practiced in different ways from different backgrounds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Richard Wrangham: Violence, Sex, and Fire in Human Evolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #229
