body.input: because you don't shed for that long in a normal infection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Now it's 10 days should be fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So what happens is you get infected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: You don't know it, of course.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: The virus starts to grow very quickly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And within four or five days, you reach a peak of shedding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: You're making a lot of RNA and you may be asymptomatic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: You're shedding, you can affect others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And then you may or may not have your symptom onset.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So you shed for a couple of days before symptom onset.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And then within three days, four days,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: the viral RNA crashes and you're no longer shedding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: You're no longer transmitting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So that's the one kind of test we have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It can tell you if you're infected at the moment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: but it won't tell you

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: if you're gonna be infected tomorrow, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Because if you're negative today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: you could be positive tomorrow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: You just might be in a different part

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: of the incubation period, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So that's one test been used the most.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: You can now get 15 minute versions of them

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: in a walk-in or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Then there are antigen tests,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: which look for the proteins that the virus is making.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So as it's reproducing in your nose,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: it's not only making genomes, it's making proteins.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And so these you can buy in the drug store.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And these would have been great if they had,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Michael Mina last year had the idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: that if we could make a little stick,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: a little piece of paper that you would suck on

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and it would tell you if you're infected or not,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: if this could cost less than a buck,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: everybody could test themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Which they can cost less than a buck, by the way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Yeah, but they were never made, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: They're never mass manufactured.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So his idea is to do like daily tests.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So, yeah, daily and then the kid's going to school,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: he's positive or she's positive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Well, if it's cheap enough, you just take another test

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: because they have a certain error frequency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: If it's positive twice, you stay home

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and the next day you try again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And I think this would have revolutionized

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: because the PCR tests are more expensive at the time

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and they take longer to do and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: But that never happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: But now we do have $20 Binax now

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and others that you can buy and people buy them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: See, but that can still happen, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And this is the very frustrating thing to me

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: because I'm worried about variants,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: but I'm also worried about future,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: much more deadly pandemics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I know we kind of said, yes, COVID, lots of deaths,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: but like it could be a lot worse too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So I'm thinking what is going to be the right response

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: for the future pandemic of its kind?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And what's the right response for continued number of variants

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and some of the variants might be deadlier

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: or more transmissible?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Well, the antigen tests will pick up the variants.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: That's not a question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: The PCR may be influenced by changes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: but you can quickly adapt the primers that you use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So that's not a problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: But that's what I mean, like to me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: all these discussions about vaccines and so on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: vaccines, we got very lucky that they took so little time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And you have to be aware, no matter what,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: that there's hesitancy with the vaccines in this country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: That's a reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: You can't just be like magically saying

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: that you're going to overcome that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And I don't think there's any hesitancy

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and cheap tests at home.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I agree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So the question is, if someone tested positive,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: would they stay home?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: That's the question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: What if their job depends on them going in?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I mean, that's-

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Well, you have to look at sort of aggregate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: how many people would decide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And I think, again, a lot of that is in leadership,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: but I think a lot of them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I would say most people would stay home.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I think that Mina had the idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and it would have changed the whole situation for sure,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: if it could have been made,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: when we talked to him last spring, I think, or summer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: We would have gotten around a lot of the issues

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: that we're in today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: because I think people would have stayed home

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and not transmitted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And I think it's still valuable to this day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: In the fall, if we don't have vaccine uptake,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: we could just test kids every day

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and keep them home when they're infected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It cuts, and we don't have it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: But I think, and I'm not privy to what was going on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: but I don't think a lot of emphasis

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: was put on testing early on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: The CDC developed the first one, it was flawed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: They had to recall the kits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I mean, that was a fiasco.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: They should have had 100 companies

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: making the tests initially, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So for the future, I think what we have learned

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: is we need to have a rapid antigen test right off the bat

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: that's doable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: You can't do it in a day like you can for PCR,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: because you need to make antibodies

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: to the protein that you're looking for,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and you need to do those in animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: But you can do it in weeks, and we should be ready for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Yeah, because, I mean, to me, that's obvious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: That's obviously the best solution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Second to that, if we understood how well masks work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Like, maybe let me ask you this question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Let's put masks aside.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: How well do we understand how COVID is transmitted?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: There's droplets of different sizes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: aerosols, tiny, tiny droplets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It seems like that's a very difficult thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: to understand thoroughly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So it seems like it's transmitted both ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It's unclear how exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So how much do we understand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and why is it so difficult to understand it fully?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Well, I think it's clear that it's transmitted

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: through the air, mostly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It's not touching.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: We thought initially it would be a lot of touch,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: but very little of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It's through the air, and when you talk,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: mainly when you talk, you expel a lot of droplets, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Even the plosives that your foam thing here,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: are meant to pee, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: That you send out little sprays,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and those have viruses in them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And the big drops fall to the ground,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and the little ones can go 100 feet or more, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: But the little ones also have less virus in them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So I'm not sure, well, we certainly do not know

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: how much virus you need to be infected,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: but it's probably at least several thousand particles,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: if not more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And it could be that for most people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: the tiny droplets don't have enough virus

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: to infect someone else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: But there's one observation about this virus

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: that's really interesting, and that is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: 80% of transmissions are done by 20% of the people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: of the infected people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Not every infected person transmits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: That's been borne out in multiple studies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And in fact, there's a study at University of Colorado

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: where they quantified the viral RNA loads

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: in all the swabs that had been done of students

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: for like a six month period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And most of the infectious virus,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: most of the RNA copies were found in 15 to 20%

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: of the people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: The rest had really low,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and that's probably why they don't transmit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So those are the ones that might get enough virus

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: in the tiny droplets to be able to infect someone

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: at a distance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And I think that's entirely possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Why is it hard to study?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: You can't do it in real life

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: because you don't know who's infected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And if you do, there's not a controlled environment

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: to measure droplets and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: You'd have to do it in a laboratory situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: If you use an animal, you just don't know

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: what the relevance of that is to people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: You'd have to use human and do challenge experiments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And we don't do that at this point,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: at least not for this virus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So that's why it's hard to know what's going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So we have to make inferences

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: from epidemiological associations

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: where you're studying say transmission in a household,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: where people are stuck in the same rooms together,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So let me ask you the why question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: What do you think is the meaning of this life of ours?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Oh, there's no meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It just happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It's an accident.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I think there's no life elsewhere

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: because this was just a rare accident that happened

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: in the right conditions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I mean, people all think I'm wrong

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: because there are billions and billions of stars out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So there's a lot of opportunity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: There's no meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It's just, what do they call it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: A perfect storm of events

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: that led to molecules being formed and eventually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I mean, it took a long time for life to evolve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: But it's just driven by conditions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: If something emerged that worked,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: it would then go on to the next step.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: There's no meaning other than that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: The only difference is that we,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and I think many other animals can probably,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: we have the ability, we're sentient, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: We can influence what happens to us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: We can take medicines, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: We can alter what would normally happen to us

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: so we can remove some of the selection pressure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: But I think everything else on the planet just goes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: looks for food and give a lot of offspring

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: so you can perpetuate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It's just a natural biological function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Yeah, they're much more directly concerned with survival.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I think humans are able to contemplate their mortality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: We can see that even if we're okay today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: we're eventually going to die

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and we really don't like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So we try to come up with ways to push that deadline

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: farther and farther away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Well, we have really,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I mean, we used to die in our 30s, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And now it's 70s, 80s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Well, most of us used to die in the first few weeks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: That's true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Yeah, infant death.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I always tell people the only thing that's 100% is death.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It's the only thing in the world that's 100%.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Do you think about your own mortality?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: No, I never think about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I'm just enjoying day to day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And I don't think about it. Really?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: You work on viruses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: You don't contemplate your own mortality

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: given the deadliness of the viruses around us?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I never thought COVID would kill me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: No, I never was afraid of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Not at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I've mostly feared for other people getting sick,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: especially people who could die

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: if I didn't want that to happen to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: But I always thought that it's obviously

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: not a realistic viewpoint not to be worried

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: because many people are,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: but I've been relatively healthy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: They should sequence my genome because it works really well

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and I have a good immune system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Maybe you'd be the first immortal person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I don't think so. There's gotta be a first.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I don't think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I think that biologically you just can't,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: the ends of our chromosomes keep getting shorter

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and shorter and that's eventually what kills us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So you just can't keep going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: But that's fine. I don't need to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I understand from the vampires

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: that it's not good to live forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I guess make the most of the time you got.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: That's the bacteria live a much shorter time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So we got that on bacteria.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Bacteria are just little bags of chemicals that split.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: So they have no stake in the matter at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It doesn't bother.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And I think you have to go a long ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: before you get into some kind of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Yeah, it's weird that this bag of chemicals

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: has a stake in the matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Like our human body is a, consciousness is a weird thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It's not just in us, but they make half of the oxygen

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: on the planet, 20% of the oxygen comes from bacteria.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And they made in the beginning of earth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: they made enough oxygen to start oxygenation going,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: life going.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I mean, they have an incredible role.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It was all an accident, just happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Well, Vincent, like I told you, I'm a huge fan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It's a big honor that you would talk to me today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Thank you so much for coming down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Thank you for spending so much time with me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And thank you for everything you do in terms of educating

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: about viruses, about biology, microbiology

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: and everything else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: I can't wait.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Everybody should check out Vincent's YouTube,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: watch his lectures, listen to the podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: It's truly incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Thank you so much for talking to me, Vincent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: My pleasure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Thanks for listening to this conversation

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: with Vincent Racanello.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: To support this podcast, please check out our sponsors

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: in the description.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: And now let me leave you with some words from Isaac Asimov.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: The saddest aspect of life right now

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: is that science gathers knowledge faster

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: than society gathers wisdom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vincent Racaniello: Viruses and Vaccines | Lex Fridman Podcast #216

body.input: Thank you for listening and hope to see you next time.

body.input: The following is a conversation with Jo Bowler,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: a mathematics educator at Stanford

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and co-founder of ucubed.org that seeks to inspire

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: young minds with the beauty of mathematics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: To support this podcast,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: please check out our sponsors in the description.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: This is the Lex Friedman podcast,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and here is my conversation with Jo Bowler.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: What to you is beautiful about mathematics?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I love a mathematics that some people don't even think of as mathematics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: which is beautiful, creative mathematics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: where we look at maths in different ways, we visualize it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: We think about different solutions to problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: A lot of people think of maths as you have one method and one answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: What I love about maths is the multiple different ways you can see things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: different methods, different ways of seeing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: In some cases, different solutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That is what is beautiful to me about mathematics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: that you can see and solve it in many different ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Also, the sad part that many people think that maths is just one answer and one method.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: To you, the beauty emerges when you have a problem with a solution

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and you start adding other solutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Simpler solutions, weirder solutions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: more interesting, some that are visual,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: some of their algebraic, geometry, all that stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah. I always say that you can take any maths area and make it visual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: We say to teachers, give us your most dry, boring maths,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and we'll make it a visual, interesting, creative problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Turns out you can do that with any area of maths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I think it's been a great disservice to kids and others that it's always been numbers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: lots and lots of numbers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Numbers can be great, but you can think about maths in other ways besides numbers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Do you find that most people are better visual learners,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: or is this just something that's complementary?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: What's the full spectrum of students and the way they like to explore maths, would you say?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: There's definitely people who come into the classes I do

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: who are more interested in visual thinking and like visual approaches.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But it turns out what the neuroscience is telling us is that when we think about maths,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: there are two visual pathways in the brain, and we should all be thinking about it visually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Some approaches have been to say, well, you're a visual learner,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: so we'll give you visuals, and you're not a visual learner.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But actually, if you think you're not a visual learner,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: it's probably more important that you have a visual approach

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: so you can develop that part of your brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You were saying that there's some kind of interconnected aspect to it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: so the visual connects with the non-visual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah, so this is what the neuroscience has shown us,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: that when you work on a maths problem, there are five different brain pathways,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and that the most high achieving people in the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: are people who have more connections between these pathways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So if you see a maths problem with numbers, but you also see it visually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: that will cause a connection to happen in your brain between these pathways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And if you maybe write about it with words, that would cause another connection,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: or maybe you build it with something physical that would cause a different connection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And what we want for kids is, we call it a multi-dimensional experience of maths,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: seeing it in different ways, experiencing it in different ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That will cause that great connected brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You know, there's these stories of physicists doing the same.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I find physicists are often better at building that part of their brain,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: of using visualization for intuition building,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: because you ultimately want to understand the deepest secret underneath this problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and for that you have to intuit your way there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And you mentioned offline that one of the ways you might approach a problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: is to try to tell a story about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And some of it is like legend, but I'm sure it's not always.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You have Einstein thinking about a train, and the speed of light,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and that kind of intuition is useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You start to imagine a physical world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: like how does this idea manifest itself in the physical world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and then start playing in your mind with that physical world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and think, is this going to be true, is this going to be true?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Einstein is well known for thinking visually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and people talk about how he really didn't want to go anywhere with problems

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: without thinking about them visually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But the other thing you mentioned that sparked something for me is thinking with intuition,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: like having intuition about math problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That's another thing that's often absent in math class,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: the idea that you might think about a problem and use your intuition, but so important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And when mathematicians are interviewed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: they will very frequently talk about the role of intuition in solving problems,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: but not commonly acknowledged or brought into education.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah, I mean, that's what it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: If you task yourself with building an intuition about a problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: that's where you start to pull in, like, what is the pattern I'm seeing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: In order to understand the pattern, you might want to then start utilizing visualization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But ultimately, that's all in service of solving the puzzle,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and cracking it open to get the simple explanation of why things are the way they are,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: as opposed to, like you said, having a particular algorithm that you can then execute to solve the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But it's hard. It's hard. The reasoning is really hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah, it's hard. I mean, I love to value what's hard in maths instead of being afraid of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: We know that when you struggle, that's actually a really good time for your brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You want to be struggling when you're thinking about things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: If it's hard to think intuitively about something, that's probably a really good time for your brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I used to work with somebody called Sebastian Thrun, who is a great mathematician, you might think of him, an AI person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I remember in one interview I did with him, he talked about how they'd built robots, I think, for the Smithsonian,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and how they were having this trouble with them picking up white noise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And he said they had to solve it, they had to work out what's going on, and how he intuitively worked out what the problem was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But then it took him three weeks to show it mathematically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I thought that was really interesting, that how you can have this intuition and know something works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It's kind of different from going through that long mathematical process of proving it, but so important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I think probably our brains are evolved as intuition machines,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and the math of showing it formally is probably an extra thing that we're not designed for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You see that with Feynman and all of these physicists, you see starting with intuition, sometimes starting with an experiment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and then the experiment inspires intuition, but you can think of an experiment as a kind of visualization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Just like, let's take whatever the heck we're looking at and draw it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and draw the pattern as it evolves, as the thing grows, for n equals one, for n equals two, n equals three, and you start to play with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: In the modern day, which I loved doing, you can write a program that then visualizes it for you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and then you can start exploring it programmatically, and then you can do so interactively too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I tend to not like interactive because it takes way too much work, because you have to click and move and stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I love to interact through writing programs, but that's my particular brain, software engineer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So you can do all these kinds of visualizations, and then there's the tools of visualization like color, all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You're absolutely right, they're actually not taught very much, like the art of visualization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Not taught. And we love as well color coding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Like when you represent something mathematically, you can show color to show the growth and kind of code that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So if I have an algebraic expression for a pattern, maybe I show the X with a certain color, but also write in that color so you can see the relationship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Very cool. And yeah, we particularly in our work with elementary teachers, many of them come to our workshops,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and they're literally in tears when they see things making sense visually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: because they've spent their whole lives not realizing you can really understand things with these visuals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It's quite powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You say that there's something valuable to learning when the thing that you're doing is challenging, is difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So a lot of people say, you know, math is hard or math is too hard or too hard for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Do you think math should be easy or should it be hard?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I think it's great when things are challenging, but there's something that that's really key to being able to deal with challenging maths,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and that is knowing that you can do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I think the problem in education is a lot of people have got this idea that you're either born with a maths brain or you're not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So when they start to struggle, they think, oh, I don't have that maths brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then they will literally sort of switch off in their brain and things will go downhill from that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So struggle becomes a lot easier and you're able to struggle if you don't have that idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But you know that you can do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You have to go through this struggle to get there, but you're able to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And so we're hampered in being able to struggle with these ideas we've been given about what we can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Ask a difficult question here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So there's kind of I don't know what the right term is, but some people are struggle with learning in different ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Like their brain is constructed in different ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And how much should as educators should we make room for that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So how do you know the difference between this is hard and I don't like doing hard things versus my brain is wired in a way?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Why I need to learn in very different ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I can't learn it this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: How do you find that line?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: How do you operate in that gray area?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So this is why being a teacher is so hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And people really don't appreciate how difficult teaching is when you're faced with, I know, 30 students who think in different ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But this is also why I believe it's so important to have this multidimensional approach to maths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: We've really offered it in one way, which is here's some numbers in a method.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You follow me, do what I just did and then reproduce it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And so there are some kids who like doing that and they do well and a lot of kids who don't like doing it and don't do well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But when you open up maths and you give you let kids experience it in different ways, maybe visually with numbers, with words.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: What happens is kids, there are many more kids who can access it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So those different brain wirings you're talking about, where some people are just more able to do something in a particular way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That's why we want to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That's one of the reasons we want to open it up so that there are different ways of accessing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then that's not really a problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So I grew up in the Soviet Union and fell in love with math early.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I was forced into math early and fell in love through force.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That's good. Well, good that you fell in love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But something we talked about a little bit is there is such a value for excellence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It's competitive and it's also everybody kind of looks up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: The definition of success is being in a particular class is being really good at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And it's not improving, it's like being really good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I mean, we are much more like that with sports, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It's understood you're going to star on the basketball team.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: If you're going to start on the basketball team, if you're going to be better than the other guys, the other girls on the team.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So that coupled with the belief, this could be partially a communist belief, I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But the belief that everybody is capable of being great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But if you're not great, that's your fault and you need to work harder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I remember I had a sense that probably delusional, but I could win a Nobel Prize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I don't even know what that entails.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But I thought, like my dad early on told me just offhand and it always stuck with me that if you can figure out how to build a time machine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: how to travel back in time, it will probably give you a Nobel Prize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I remember early in my life thinking, I'm going to invent the time machine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And like the tools of mathematics were in service of that dream of winning the Nobel Prize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And it's silly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I didn't really think in those concrete terms, but I just thought I could be great, that feeling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then when you struggle, the belief that you could be great is like struggle is good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Right, pushes you on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And so the other thing about the Soviet system that might love to hear your comments about is just the sheer like hours of math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Like the number of courses you're talking about, a lot of geometry, a lot more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I think in the American system, you take maybe one year of geometry in high school.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: First of all, geometry is beautiful, it's visual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then you get to reason through proofs and stuff like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: In Russia, I remember just being nailed over and over with you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It was just nonstop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then, of course, there's different perspectives on calculus and just the whole.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: The sense was that math is like fundamental to the development of the human mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So math, but also science and literature, by the way, was also hit very hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Like we read a lot of serious adult stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: America does that a little bit, too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: They challenge young adults with good literature, but they don't challenge adults very much with math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So those two things, valuing excellence and just a lot of math in the curriculum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Do you think do you think do you find that interesting?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Because it seems to have been successful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah, I think that's very interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And there is a lot of success people coming through the Soviet system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I think something that's very different to the US and other countries in the world is that idea that excellence is important and you can get there if you work hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: In the US, there's an idea that excellence is important, but then kids are given the idea in many ways that you can either do it or you're one of the people who can't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So many students in the school system think they're one of the kids who can't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So there's no point in trying hard because you're never going to get there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So if you can switch that idea, it would be huge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And it seems from what you've said that in the Soviet Union, that idea is really different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Now, the downside of that idea that anybody can get there if you work hard is that thought that if you're not getting there, it's your fault.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I would add something into that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I would say that anybody can get there, but they need to work hard and they also need good teaching because there are some people who really can't get there because they're not given access to that good teaching.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So, but that would be huge, that change as to doing lots of maths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: If maths was interesting and open and creative and multidimensional, I would be all for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: We actually run summer camps at Stanford where we invite kids in and we give them this maths that I love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And in our camp classrooms, they were three hours long.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And when we were planning, the teachers were like, three hours, are we going to be able to keep the kids excited for three hours?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Turned out they didn't want to go to break or lunch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: They'd be so into these mathematical patterns.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: We couldn't stop them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It was amazing.
