metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So, yeah, if maths was more like that, then I think having more of it would be a really good thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So what age are you talking about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Is there, could you comment on what age is like the most important when people quit math or give up on themselves or on math in general?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And perhaps that age or something earlier is really an important moment for them to discover, to be inspired to discover the magic of math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I think a lot of kids start to give up on themselves and maths around from about fifth grade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then those middle school years are really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And fifth grade can be pivotal for kids just because they're allowed to explore and think in good ways in the early grades of elementary school.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But fifth grade teachers are often like, OK, we're going to prepare you now for middle school and we're going to give you grades and lots of tests.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And that's when kids start to feel really badly about themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And so middle school years, we, our camps are middle school students.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: We think of those years as really pivotal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Many kids in those years are deciding, yes, I'm going to keep going with STEM subjects or no, I'm not, that this isn't for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So, I mean, all years are important and in all years you can kind of switch kids and get them on a different pathway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But I think those middle school years are really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So what's the role of the teacher in this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So one is the explanation of the subject, but do you think teachers should almost do like one on one, you know, little Johnny, I believe in you kind of thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Like that energy of like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Turns out it's really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: There's a study that was done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It was actually done in high school English classrooms where all kids wrote an essay for their teacher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And this was done as an experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Half of the kids got feedback from their teacher, diagnostic feedback, which is great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But for half of the kids, it said an extra sentence at the bottom that the researchers had put on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And the kids who read that extra sentence did significantly better in English a whole year later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: The only change was this one sentence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: What did the sentence say?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So what did the sentence say?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: The sentence said, I'm giving you this feedback because I believe in you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And the kids who read that did better a year later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So when I share this with teachers, I say, you know, I'm not suggesting you put on the bottom of all kids work and giving this feedback.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So I believe in you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: One of the teachers said to me, we don't put it on a stamp.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I said, no, don't put it on a stamp.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It's but your words are really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And kids are sitting in classrooms all the time thinking, what does my teacher think of me?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Does my teacher think I can do this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So it turns out it is really important to be saying to kids, I know you can do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And those messages are not given enough by teachers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And really believe it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And believe it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah, it's like you can't just say it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You have to believe it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I sometimes because it's like it's such a funny dance because I'm such a perfectionist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I'm extremely self-critical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I have one of the students come up to me and it's clear to me that they're not even close to good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And it's tempting for me to be like to sort of give up on them mentally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But the reality is, like, if you look at many great people throughout history, they sucked at some point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And some of the greatest took nonlinear paths to where they sucked for long into later life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And so always kind of believing that this person can be great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You have to communicate that plus the fact that they have to work hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That's it. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah, and you're right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Silicon Valley, where I live, is filled with people who are dropouts of school or who had special needs, who didn't succeed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It's very interesting that have gone on to do amazing work in creative ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I mean, I do think our school system is set up to value good memorizers who can reproduce what a teacher is showing them and push away those creative deep thinkers, often slower thinkers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: They think slowly and deeply and they often get the idea early on that they can't be good at maths or other subjects.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So, yeah, I think many of those people are the ones who go on and do amazing things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So there's a guy named Eric Weinstein.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I know many mathematicians like this, but he talks a lot about having a nonstandard way of learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I mean, a lot of great mathematicians, a lot of great physicists are like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And he felt like he became quickly, he got his PhD at Harvard, became quickly an outcast of the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: The education, especially early education system didn't help him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Is there ways for an education system to support people like that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Is it this kind of multi-dimensional learning that you're mentioning?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Absolutely. I mean, I think education system still uses an approach that was in classrooms hundreds of years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: The textbooks have a lot to answer for in producing this very uninspiring mathematics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But yeah, if you open up the subject and have people see and solve it in different ways and value those different ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Somebody I appreciated a lot is a mathematician called Maryam Mizikhani.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I don't know if you've heard of her. She won the Fields Medal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: She was from Iran, first woman in the world to win the Fields Medal in mathematics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: She died when she was 40, she was at Stanford.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But her work was entirely visual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And she talked about how her daughter thought she was an artist because she was always visualizing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I attended, she asked me to chair the PhD defense for one of her students.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I went to the defense in the math department.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And it was so interesting because this young woman spent like two hours sharing her work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: All of it was visual. In fact, I don't think I saw any numbers at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I remember that day thinking, wow, I could have brought her like 13 year old into this PhD defense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: They would not recognize this as maths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But when Maryam Mizikhani won the Fields Medal, all these other mathematicians were saying that her work had connected all these previously unconnected areas of maths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And so, but when she was, she also shared that when she was in school, when she was about 13, she was told that she couldn't do maths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: She was told that by her teacher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: This is Iran?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: In Iran, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So I love that, you know, to be told you can't be good at maths and then go on and win the Fields Medal is cool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I've been told by a lot of people in my life that I can't do something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I'm very definitely nonstandard. But all it takes, that's why people talk about like the one teacher that changed everything for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: All it takes is one teacher. That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That's the power of that. So that should be inspiring to teachers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I think it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You as a single person, given the education system, given the incentives, you have the power to truly change lives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And like 20 years from now, Fields Medalists will walk up to you and say thank you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You did that for me. Yeah, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I share that with teachers that even in this broken system of what they have to do for districts and textbooks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: a single teacher can change kids' maths relationship or other subjects and forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: What's the role of the parents in this picture? Let's go to another difficult subject.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah, that is a difficult subject.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: One study found that the amount of maths anxiety parents had predicted their child's achievement in school,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: but only if they helped with homework.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So. That's so funny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah. There were some interesting implications for this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I mean, you can see how it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: If you have maths anxiety and you're helping your kids with homework, you're probably communicating things like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I was terrible at this at school. And that's how it gets passed on to kids.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So one implication is if you have a really bad relationship with maths, you hate maths, you have maths anxiety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Just don't do maths homework with your kids.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But we have on our website, we have a little sheet for parents of ways to interact around maths with your kids.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And that's youcubed.org.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That's youcubed.org. Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So one of the things I say to parents when I give parent presentations is even if you hate maths, you need to just fake it with your kids.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You should be always endlessly optimistic and happy about doing maths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I'm always curious about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So I hope to have kids one day. I don't have kids currently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Are parents OK with like sucking at math and then trying to get their kid to be better than them essentially?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Like, is that difficult thing for a lot of parents? It is difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: To have like it's almost an ego thing. Like, I never got good at this and I probably should have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And yeah, I mean, to me, that's you want to celebrate that. But I know a lot of people struggle with that, like coaches in sports to make an athlete become better than them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It can be hard on the ego. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So do you experience the same with parents, too?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I think I mean, I have an experience parents worrying that their kids will be better than them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I have experienced parents just having a really bad relationship with maths and not wanting to help, not knowing how to help, saying things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Like another study showed that when mothers say to their daughters, I was bad at maths in school, their daughter's achievement goes down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So we know that kids pick up on these messages, which is why I say you should fake it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But also, I know that lots of people have just had a really bad relationship with maths, even successful people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: The undergrads I teach at Stanford have pretty much always done well in maths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But they come to Stanford thinking maths is a set of methods to memorize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And so so do many parents believe that there's one method that you memorize and then you reproduce it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So until people have really had an experience of what I think of as the other maths,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: but until they've really seen that it's a really different subject.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It's hard for them to be able to shift their kids to see it differently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Is there for a teacher, if we're to like systematize it, is there something teachers can do to do this more effectively?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So you mentioned the textbook. So what are the additional things you can add on top of this whole old school,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: traditional way of teaching that can improve the process?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So I do think there's a way of teaching maths that changes everything for kids and teachers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So I'm one of five writers of a new framework for the state of California, a new maths framework is coming out next year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And we are recommending through this maths framework that people teach in this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It's called teaching to big ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So at the moment, people have standards that have been written and then textbooks have taken these standards and made not very good questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And if you look at the standards, like I have some written down here, just reading the standards, it makes maths seem really boring and uninspiring.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: What are the kind of, can you give a few examples?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So this is an interesting example. In third grade, there are three different standards about unit squares.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: OK.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So this is one of them. A square with side length, one unit called a unit square is said to have one square unit of area and can be used to measure area.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And that's something you're expected to learn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That is something that's a standard. The textbook authors say, oh, I'm going to make a question about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And they translate the standards into narrow questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then you measure success by your ability to deliver on these standards.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So the standards themselves, I think of maths and many people think maths in this way is a subject of like a few big ideas and really important connections between them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So like you could think of it as like a network map of ideas and connections.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And what standards do is they take that beautiful map and they chop it up like this into lots of little pieces and they deliver the pieces to schools.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And so teachers don't see the connections between ideas nor do the kids.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So anyway, this is a bit of a long way of saying that what we've done in this new initiative is we have set out maths as a set of big ideas and connections between them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So this is a grade three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So instead of there being 60 standards, we've said, well, you can pull these different standards to get in with each other and also value the ways these are connected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And by the way, for people who are just listening, we're looking at a small number of like big concepts within mathematics, square tiles, measuring fraction, shape and time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and then how they're interconnected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And so the goal is for this is for grade three, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah. And so we've set out for the state of California, the whole of mathematics K10 as a set of big ideas and connections.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So we know that teachers, it works really well if they say, OK, so a big idea in my grade is measuring.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And instead of reading five procedural statements that involve measuring, they think, measuring is a big idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: What rich, deep activity can I use that teachers measuring to kids?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And as kids work on these deep, rich activities, maybe over a few days turns out a lot of maths comes into it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So we're recommending that let's not teach maths according to all these multiple, multiple statements and lots and lots of short questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Instead, let's teach maths by thinking about what are the big ideas and what are really rich, deep activities that teach those big ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So that's the like how you teach it and maximise learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: What about like from a school district perspective, like measuring how well you're doing, grades and tests and stuff like that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Do you throw those out or is it possible?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I'm not a fan of grades and tests myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I think grades are fine if they're used at the end of a course.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So at the end of my maths course, I might get a grade because a grade is meant to be a summative measure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It kind of describes your summative achievement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But the problem we have in maths classrooms across the US is people use grades all the time, every week or every day even.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: My own kids, when they went through high school, technology has not helped with this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: When they went through high school, they knew they were being graded for everything they did, everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And not only were they being graded for everything, but they could see it in the gradebook online and it would alter every class they went into.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So this is the ultimate what I think of as a performance culture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You're there to perform. Somebody's measuring you. You see your score.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So I think that's not conducive for deep learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And yes, have a grade at the end of the year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But during the year, you can assess kids in much better ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Teachers can, a great way of assessing kids is to give them a rubric that kind of outlines what they're learning over the course of a unit or a few weeks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So kids can actually see the journey they're on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Like, this is what we're doing mathematically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Sometimes they self-assess on those units and then teachers will show what the kids can do with a rubric and also write notes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Like, you know, in the next few weeks, you might like to learn to do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So so instead of kids just thinking about I'm an A kid or a B kid or I have this letter attached to me, they're actually seeing mathematically what's important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And they're involved in the process of knowing where they are mathematically at the end of the year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Sure, they can have a grade. But during the year, they get these much more informative measures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I do think this this might be more for college, but maybe not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Some of the best classes I've had is when I got a special like set aside like the professor clearly saw that I was interested in some aspect of a thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then I've a few in mind and one in particular, when he said that he kind of challenged me. So this is outside of grades and all that kind of stuff that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Basically, it's like reverse psychology. I don't I don't think this can be done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And so I gave everything to do that particular thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So this was happened to be an artificial intelligence class.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But I think that like special treatment of taking students who are especially like excellent at a particular little aspect, do you see their eyes light up?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I often think like maybe it's tempting for a teacher to think you've already succeeded there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: but they're actually signaling to you that like you could really launch them on their way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah. And I don't know. That's too much to expect from teachers, I think, to to to pay attention to all of that, because it's really difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But I just kind of remember who are the biggest, the most important people in the history of my life of education.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And it's those people that who really didn't just like inspire me with their awesomeness, which they did, but also just they pushed me a little.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah, like it gave me a little push. And that requires focusing on the quote unquote excellent students in the class.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah. I think what's important, though, is teachers to have the perspective that they don't know who's going to be excellent at something before they give out the activity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Exactly. And in our camp classes that we ran, sometimes students would finish ahead of other students.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And we would say to them, can you write a question that's like this, but different?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Oh, and over time, we encourage them to like extend things further.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I remember we were doing one activity where kids were working at the borders of a square and how big this border would be in different case sizes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And one of the boys came up at the end of the class and said, I've been thinking about how you do this with the Pentagon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I said, that's fantastic. How do you have what does it look like with Pentagon?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Go find out, see if you can discover. So I didn't know he was going to come up and say that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I didn't have in my head like this is the kid who could have this extension task.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But you can still do that as a teacher when kids get excited about something or they're doing well in something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Have them extend it, go further. It's great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then you also like this is like teacher and coach. You could say it in different ways to different students.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Like for me, the right thing to say is almost to say, I don't think you could do this. This is too hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Like that's what I need to hear. It's like, no, you know, there's immediate push.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But with some people, if they're a little bit more, I mean, it all has to do with upbringing, how your genetics is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: They might be much more that might break them. Yeah, that might break them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So you have to be also sensitive to that. I mean, teaching is really difficult. It is really difficult for this very reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It is. So what is the best way to teach math, to learn math at those early few days when you just want to capture them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I do something. Actually, there's a video of me doing this on our website that I love when I first.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Meet students and this is what I do. I show them a picture. This is the picture I show them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And it's a picture of seven dots like this. And I show it for just a few seconds and I say to them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I'd like you to tell me how many dots there are, but I don't need to count them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I want to group the dots and I show it them. And then I, I, I take it away before they've even had enough time to count them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then I asked them, so how did you see it? And I go around the room and amazingly enough,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: there's probably 18 different ways of seeing these seven dots. And so I asked people, tell me how you grouped it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And some people see it as like an outside hole with a center dot. Some people see like stripes of lines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Some people see segments and I collect them all and I put them on the board.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And at the end I say, look at this, we are a class of 30 kids and we saw these seven dots in 18 different ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: There's actually a mathematical term for this. It's called groupitizing. Groupitizing. Yeah. I like it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It's kind of cool. So turns out though that how well you groupitize predicts how well you do in maths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Is it a raw talent or is it just something that you can develop?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I don't think you're born groupitizing, I think, but some kids have developed that ability, if you like, and you can learn it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You can. So this to me is part of how wrong we have maths that we think to tell whether a kid's good at maths,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: we're going to give them a speed test on fact, on multiples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But actually seeing how kids group dots could be a more important assessment of how well they're going to do maths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Anyway, I diverge. What I like to do though when I start off with kids is show them, I'm going to give you maths problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I'm going to value the different ways you see them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And turns out you can do this kind of problem asking people how they group dots with young children or with graduate students.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And it's engaging for all of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You talk about creativity a little bit and flexibility in your book Limitless. What's the role of that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So it sounds like there's a bit of that kind of thing involved in groupitizing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I love this term. So what would you say is the role of creativity and flexibility in the learning of math?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I think what we know now is that what we need for this 21st century world we live in is a flexible mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: School should not really be about teaching kids particular methods, but teaching them to approach problems with flexibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Being creative, thinking creatively is really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So people don't think the words maths and creativity come together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But that's what I love about maths is the creative different ways you can see it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And so helping our kids. There's a book I like a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It's been by physicists. You probably know this book called Elastic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You might know it. And it's about how we want elastic minds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Same kind of thing. Flexible creative minds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And schools do very little on developing that kind of mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: They do a lot of developing the kind of mind that a computer now does for us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Memorization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Memorization. Doing procedures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: A lot of things that we spend a lot of time in school on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: In the world when kids leave school, a computer will do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And better than they will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But that creative, flexible thinking, we're kind of at ground zero at computers being able to engage in that thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Maybe we're a little above ground zero, but the human brain is perfectly suited for that creative, flexible thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That's what humans are so great at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So I would like the balance to shift in schools.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Maybe you still need to do some procedural kind of thinking, but there should be a lot more of that creative, flexible thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And what's the role of other humans in this picture?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So collaborative learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So brainstorming together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So creativity as it emerges from the collective intelligence of multiple humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah. Super important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And we know that also helps develop your brain, that social side of thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I love mathematics collaboration where people build on each other's ideas and they come up with amazing things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I actually taught a hundred students calculus at Stanford recently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Undergrads. And we taught them to collaborate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So these students came in Stanford and most of them were against collaboration in math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: This is before COVID in person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah, it was just before COVID hit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It was 2019.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And this summer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So you said they're against such a good way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It's really interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So they'd only experience maths individually in a kind of competitive individual way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And if they had experienced it as group work, it had been a bad experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Maybe they were the one who did it all and the others didn't do much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So they were kind of against collaboration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: They didn't see any role for it in maths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And we taught them to collaborate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And it was hard work because as well as the fact that they were kind of against collaboration,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: they came in with a lot of like social comparison thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So I'm in this room with other Stanford undergrads and they're better than me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So when we set them to work on a maths problem together, the first one was kind of a disaster

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: because they were all like, they're better than me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: They're faster than me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: They came up with something I didn't come up with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So we taught them to let go of that thinking and to work well together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And one of the things we did, we decided we wanted to do a pre and post test at the end of this teaching.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It was only four weeks long.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But we knew we didn't want to give them like a time test of individual work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So we gave them an applied problem to do at the beginning and we gave them to do in pairs together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And we gave each of them a different colored pen and said, work on this activity together and keep using that pen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So then we had all these pieces of student work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And what we saw was they just worked on separate parts of the paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So there's a little like red pen section and a green pen section.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And they didn't do that well on it, even though it was a problem that middle or high school kids could do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But it was like a problem solving kind of problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then we gave them the same one to do at the end, gave them the same colors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And actually, they had learned to collaborate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And not only were they collaborating the second time around, but that boosted their achievement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And the ones who collaborated did better on the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Collaboration is important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Having people and what was so eye opening for these undergrads.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And they talked about it in lovely ways was I learned to value other people's thinking on a problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I learned to value that other people saw it in different ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And it was quite a big experience for them that they came out thinking, you know, I can do maths with other people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: People can see it differently. We can build on each other's way, ways of thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I got a chance to I don't know if you know who Daniel Kahneman is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I got a chance to interact with him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And like the first because he had a few, but one famous collaboration throughout his life with Tversky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And it's just like, you know, he hasn't met me before in person, but just the number of questions he was asking, just the curiosity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So I think one of the skills, the collaboration itself is a skill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I remember my experience with him was like, OK, I get why you're so good at collaboration,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: because he was just extremely good at listening and genuine curiosity about how the other person thinks about the world, sees the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then together he pulled me in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: In that particular case, he doesn't know in particular like that much about autonomous vehicles, but he kept like asking all these questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then like 10 minutes in, we're together trying to solve the problem of autonomous driving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And like and that, I mean, that's really fulfilling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That's really enriching. But it also in that moment made me realize it's kind of a skill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You have to kind of put your ego aside, put your view of the world aside and try to learn how the other person sees it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And the other thing you have to put aside is this social comparison.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Thinking if you are sitting there thinking, wow, that was an amazing idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: He's so much better than I am.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That's really going to stop you taking on the value of that idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And so there's a lot of that going on between these Stanford students when they came and yeah, trying to help them let go of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: One of the things I've discovered just because being a little bit more in the public eye, how rewarding it is to celebrate others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And how much is going to actually pay off in the long term.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So this kind of silo thinking of like, I want to prove to a small set of people around me that I'm really smart and do so by basically not celebrating how smart the other people are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That's actually maybe short term. It seems like a good strategy, but long term it's not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And I think if you practice at the student level and then at the career at every single stage, I think that's ultimately.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I agree with you. I think that's a really good way of thinking about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And it's a similar, I mean, a question I get asked a lot is about homework.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And one of the recommendations I give is to not have kids just do lots of questions for

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: What did you struggle with?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Um, then kids go home and they have to kind of reflect in a deeper way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: A lot of times, I don't know if you had this experience as a math student, lots of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Kids are going through maths questions, they're successful, they get them right, but they

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: don't even really know what they're about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And a lot of kids go through many years of maths like that doing lots of questions, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: really knowing what even the topic is or what it's about, what it's important for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So having students go back and think at the end of a day, what was the big idea from this

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: maths lesson?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Why is it important?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Where would I find that in real life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Those are really good questions for kids to be thinking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: It's probably for everybody to be thinking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I think most of us go through life never asking like the bigger question, almost like, you

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: know, those like layers of why questions that kids ask when they're very young.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And we just keep doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: We do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Like what, that's the, you know, whatever the term is, you call first principles thinking,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Like the reason we did it this way is because it works for this reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: There might be other ways and that's how invention happens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then you get, you know, that's really useful in every aspect of life, like choosing

body.input: like everything.

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: That would be good if we started doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: But anyway, I can remember where I was sitting and everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Yeah.

body.input: To do it right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You have to time it right because that kind of humor is probably better for when you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: in grad school versus when you're in early education.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Well, and I guess kids or young people get whether somebody's doing it to be funny or

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: has it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: On the flip side, one positive statement to keep them going.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I myself had one teacher who was really amazing for me in maths, and she kept me in the subject.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Anyways, she was my teacher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: For the first time in my whole career in maths, she would give us problems and tell us to

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: and that was it.

body.input: students, I started to hear other people's ways of thinking and seeing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: You know, we live in a world full of distractions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I think giving kids really inspiring deep problems, and we have some on our website,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: is a really important experience for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: Even if they only do it occasionally, but it's really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: I say to them, all right, I'm going to check in with you after an hour.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: They think it's shocking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: And then they work on this problem, and after an hour, I say, okay, how are we doing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

metadata.title: Podcast: Jo Boaler: How to Learn Math | Lex Fridman Podcast #226

body.input: So your group at MIT is trying to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Biology of Disease | Lex Fridman Podcast #133

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Biology of Disease | Lex Fridman Podcast #133

body.input: and so on and so forth.

body.input: to that gene is related to a particular human disease,

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Biology of Disease | Lex Fridman Podcast #133

body.input: I can now go and understand the function

body.input: But this is all changing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Biology of Disease | Lex Fridman Podcast #133

body.input: This is dramatically changed.

body.input: So that was the old way of doing basic biology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Biology of Disease | Lex Fridman Podcast #133

body.input: You would start with the animal models,

body.input: So an engineer builds systems,

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Biology of Disease | Lex Fridman Podcast #133

body.input: to understand disease?
