metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: base and so on. And it noticed that all of them were people except for it because it

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: was also allowed to. And so it said, am I a person? And we had to tell it very sadly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: no, you're not. So moments like that where it asks questions that are unintentionally

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: poignant are worth treasuring.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That is powerful. That's such a powerful question. It has to do with basic control who can access

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: the system, who can modify it. But that's when those questions, like what rights do

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I have as a system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Well that's another issue, which is there'll be a thin envelope of time between when we

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: have general AIs and when everyone realizes that they should have basic human rights and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: freedoms and so on. Right now we don't think twice about effectively enslaving our email

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: systems and our series and our Alexis and so on. But at some point they'll be as deserving

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of freedom as human beings are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Yeah I'm very much with you, but it does sound absurd. And I happen to believe that it'll

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: happen in our lifetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That's why I think there'll be a narrow envelope of time when we'll keep them as essentially

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: indentured servants and after which we'll have to realize that they should have freedoms

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: that we give, that we afford to other people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And all of that starts with a system like Psych raising a single question about who

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: can modify stuff. I think that's how it starts. That's the start of a revolution. What about

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: other stuff like love and consciousness and all those kinds of topics? Do they come up

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: in Psych in the knowledge base?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Oh of course. So an important part of human knowledge, in fact it's difficult to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: human behavior and human history without understanding human emotions and why people do things and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: how emotions drive people to do things. All of that is extremely important in getting

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Psych to understand things. For example, in coming up with scenarios. So one of the applications

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: that Psych does, one kind of application it does is to generate plausible scenarios of

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: what might happen and what might happen based on that and what might happen based on that

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: and so on. So you generate this ever-expanding sphere if you will of possible future things

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to worry about or think about. And in some cases those are intelligence agencies doing

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: possible terrorist scenarios so that we can defend against terrorist threats before we

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: see the first one. Sometimes they are computer security attacks so that we can actually close

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: loopholes and vulnerabilities before the very first time someone actually exploits those

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: and so on. Sometimes they are scenarios involving more positive things involving our plans like

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: for instance what college should we go to, what career should we go into and so on, what

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: professional training should I take on, that sort of thing. So there are all sorts of useful

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: scenarios that can be generated that way of cause and effect and cause and effect that

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: go out. And many of the linkages in those scenarios, many of the steps involve understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: and reasoning about human motivations, human needs, human emotions, what people are likely

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to react to in something that you do and why and how and so on. So that was always a very

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: important part of the knowledge that we had to represent in the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So I talk a lot about love so I gotta ask, do you remember off the top of your head how

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: psych is trying to, is able to represent various aspects of love that are useful for understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: human nature and therefore integrating into this whole knowledge base of common sense?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: What is love?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: We try to tease apart concepts that have enormous complexities to them and variety to them down

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to the level where you don't need to tease them apart further.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So love is too general of a term, it's not useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Exactly. So when you get down to romantic love and sexual attraction, you get down to

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: parental love, you get down to filial love and you get down to love of doing some kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of activity or creating. So eventually you get down to maybe 50 or 60 concepts, each

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of which is a kind of love, they're interrelated and then each one of them has idiosyncratic

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: things about it. And you don't have to deal with love to get to that level of complexity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: even something like in, X being in Y, meaning physically in Y. We may have one English word

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: in to represent that, but it's useful to tease that apart because the way that the liquid

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: is in the coffee cup is different from the way that the air is in the room, which is

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: different from the way that I'm in my jacket and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And so there are questions like if I look at this coffee cup, well, I see the liquid,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: if I turn it upside down, will the liquid come out and so on. If I have say coffee with

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: sugar in it, if I do the same thing, the sugar doesn't come out, right? It stays in the liquid

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: because it's dissolved in the liquid and so on. So by now we have about 75 different kinds

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of in in the system and it's important to distinguish those. So if you're reading along

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: an English text and you see the word in, the writer of that was able to use this one innocuous

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: word because he or she was able to assume that the reader had enough common sense and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: world knowledge to disambiguate which of these 75 kinds of in they actually meant. And the

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: same thing with love. You may see the word love, but if I say, I love ice cream, that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: obviously different than if I say, I love this person or I love to go fishing or something

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: like that. So you have to be careful not to take language too seriously because people

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: have done a kind of parsimony, a kind of terstness where you have as few words as you can because

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: otherwise you'd need half a million words in your language, which is a lot of words.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That's like 10 times more than most languages really make use of and so on. Just like we

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: have on the order of about a million concepts in psych because we've had to tease apart

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: all these things. And so when you look at the name of a psych term, most of the psych

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: terms actually have three or four English words in a phrase which captures the meaning

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of this term because you have to distinguish all these types of love, you have to distinguish

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: all these types of in, and there's not a single English word which captures most of these

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Yeah. And it seems like language when used for communication between humans, almost as

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: a feature has some ambiguity built in. It's not an accident because the human condition

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: is a giant mess. And so it feels like nobody wants two robots, very precise formal logic

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: conversation on a first date. There's some dance of uncertainty, of wit, of humor, of

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: push and pull and all that kind of stuff. If everything is made precise, then life is

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: not worth living I think in terms of the human experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And we've all had this experience of creatively misunderstanding. One of my favorite stories

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: involving Marvin Minsky is when I asked him about how he was able to turn out so many

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: fantastic PhDs, so many fantastic people who did great PhD theses. How did he think of

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: all these great ideas? What he said is he would generally say something that didn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: exactly make sense, he didn't really know what it meant, but the student would figure

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: out, oh my God, Minsky said this, it must be a great idea. And he'd sweat, he or she

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: would work on work and work until they found some meaning in this Chauncey Gardner utterance

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: that Minsky had made. And then some great thesis would come out of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Yeah. I love this so much because there's young people come up to me and I'm distinctly

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: made aware that the words I say have a long lasting impact. I will now start doing the

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Minsky method of saying something cryptically profound and then letting them actually make

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: something useful and great out of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: You have to become revered enough that people will take as a default that everything you

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: say is profound.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Yes, exactly. Exactly. I mean, I love Marvin Minsky so much. There's so much, I've heard

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: this interview with him where he said that the key to his success has been to hate everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: he's ever done, like in the past. He has so many good like one liners and just, or also

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to work on things that nobody else is working on because he's not very good at doing stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Oh, I think that was just false.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Well, but see, I took whatever he said and I ran with it and I thought it was profound

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: because it's Marvin Minsky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But a lot of behavior is in the eye of the beholder and a lot of the meaning is in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: eye of the beholder. One of Minsky's early programs was begging program. Are you familiar

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: with this? So this was back in the day when you had job control cards at the beginning

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of your IBM card deck that said things like how many CPU seconds to allow this to run

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: before it got kicked off because computer time was enormously expensive. And so he wrote

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: but there could be magic moments where the community builds up large enough to where

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And then as you know, that requires a little bit leap of faith because you're now surfing

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: and there'll be obviously competitors that will pop up and start making you nervous and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: all that kind of stuff. So do you think about the space of open sourcing some parts and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: not others, how to leverage the community, all those kinds of things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That's a good question. And I think you phrased it the right way, which is we're constantly

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: struggling with the question of what to open source, what to make public, what to even

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: publicly talk about. And it's, there are enormous pluses and minuses to every alternative. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: it's very much like negotiating a very treacherous path. Partly the analogy is like if you slip,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: you could make a fatal mistake, give away something which essentially kills you or fail

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to give away something which failing to give it away hurts you and so on. So it is a very

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: tough question. Usually what we have done with people who approached us to collaborate

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: on research is to say, we will make available to you the entire knowledge base and executable

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: copies of all of the code, but only very, very limited source code access if you have

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: some idea for how you might improve something or work with us on something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So let me also get back to one of the very, very first things we talked about here, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: was separating the question of how could you get a computer to do this at all versus how

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: could you get a computer to do this efficiently enough in real time? And so one of the early

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: lessons we learned was that we had to separate the epistemological problem of what should

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: the system know, separate that from the heuristic problem of how can the system reason efficiently

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: with what it knows? And so instead of trying to pick one representation language which

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: was the sweet spot or the best trade-off point between expressiveness of the language and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: efficiency of the language, if you had to pick one, knowledge graphs would probably

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: be associative triples would probably be about the best you could do. And that's why we started

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: there. But after a few years, we realized that what we could do is we could split this

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: and we could have one nice, clean epistemological level language, which is this higher order

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: logic. And we could have one or more grubby but efficient heuristic level modules that

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: opportunistically would say, oh, I can make progress on what you're trying to do over

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: here. I have a special method that will contribute a little bit toward a solution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Of course, some subset of that knowledge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Yes, exactly. So by now we have over a thousand of these heuristic level modules and they

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: function as a kind of community of agents. And there's one of them, which is a general

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: theorem prover. And in theory, that's the only one you need. But in practice, it always

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: takes so long that you never want to call on it. You always want these other agents

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to very efficiently reason through it. It's sort of like if you're balancing a chemical

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: equation. You could go back to first principles, but in fact, there are algorithms which are

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: vastly more efficient. Or if you're trying to solve a quadratic equation, you could go

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: back to first principles of mathematics. But it's much better to simply recognize that

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: this is a quadratic equation and apply the binomial formula and snap, you get your answer

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: right away and so on. So think of these as like a thousand little experts that are all

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: looking at everything the site gets asked and looking at everything that every other

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: little agent has contributed almost like notes on a blackboard, notes on a whiteboard, and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: making additional notes when they think they can be helpful. And gradually that community

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of agents gets an answer to your question, gets a solution to your problem. And if we

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: ever come up in a domain application where psych is getting the right answer but taking

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: too long, then what we'll often do is talk to one of the human experts and say, here's

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: the set of reasoning steps that psych went through. You can see why it took it a long

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: time to get the answer. How is it that you were able to answer that question in two seconds?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And occasionally you'll get an expert who just says, well, I just know it. I just was

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: able to do it or something. And then you don't talk to them anymore. But sometimes you'll

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: get an expert who says, well, let me introspect on that. Yes, here is a special representation

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: we use just for aqueous chemistry equations. Or here's a special representation and a

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: special technique which we can now apply to things in this special representation and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: so on. And then you add that as the thousand and first HL heuristic level module. And from

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: then on in any application, if it ever comes up again, it'll be able to contribute and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: so on. So that's pretty much one of the main ways in which psych has recouped this lost

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: efficiency. A second important way is meta reasoning. So you can speed things up by focusing

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: on removing knowledge from the system till all it has left is like minimal knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: needed. But that's the wrong thing to do. That would be like in a human extrapainting

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: part of their brain or something. That's really bad. So instead what you want to do is give

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: it meta level advice, tactical and strategic advice that enables it to reason about what

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: kind of knowledge is going to be relevant to this problem. What kind of tactics are

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: going to be good to take in trying to attack this problem? When is it time to start trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to prove the negation of this thing because I'm knocking myself out trying to prove it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: true and maybe it's false. And if I just spend a minute, I can see that it's false or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So it's like dynamically pruning the graph to only like based on the particular thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: you're trying to infer. Yes. And so by now we have about 150 of these sort of like breakthrough

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: ideas that have led to dramatic speed ups in the inference process where one of them

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: was this EL-HL split and lots of HL modules. Another one was using meta and meta-meta level

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: reasoning to reason about the reasoning that's going on and so on. And 150 breakthroughs

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: may sound like a lot, but if you divide by 37 years, it's not as impressive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So there's these kind of heuristic modules that really help improve the inference. How

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: hard in general is this because you mentioned higher order logic, you know, in the general

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: the theorem prover sense, it's intractable, very difficult problem. Yes. So how hard is

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: this inference problem when we're not talking about if we let go of the perfect and focus

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: on the good? I would say it's half of the problem in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: following empirical sense, which is over the years about half of our effort, maybe 40%

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of our effort has been our team of inference programmers and the other 50-60% has been

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: our ontologists or ontological engineers putting in knowledge. So our ontological engineers

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: in most cases don't even know how to program. They have degrees in things like philosophy

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: and so on. So it's almost like the- I love that. I'd love to hang out with those people

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: actually. Oh yes, it's wonderful. But it's very much

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: like the Eloy and the Morlocks in H.G. Wells' Time Machine. So you have the Eloy who only

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: program in the epistemological higher order logic language. Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And then you have the Morlocks who are like under the ground figuring out what the machinery

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: is that will make this efficiently operate and so on. And so occasionally they'll toss

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: messages back to each other and so on. But it really is almost this 50-50 split between

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: finding clever ways to recoup efficiency when you have an expressive language and putting

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: in the content of what the system needs to know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And yeah, both are fascinating. To some degree, the entirety of the system, as far as I understand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: is written in various variants of Lisp. So my favorite program language is still Lisp.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I don't program in it much anymore because the world has- the majority of its system

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: has moved on. Everybody respects Lisp, but many of the systems are not written in Lisp

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: anymore. But Syke, as far as I understand, maybe you can correct me, there's a bunch

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of Lisp in it. Yeah. So it's based on a Lisp code that we

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: produced. Most of the programming is still going on in a dialect of Lisp. And then for

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: efficiency reasons, that gets automatically translated into things like Java or C. Nowadays,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: it's almost all translated into Java because Java has gotten good enough that that's really

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: all we need to do. So it's translated into Java and then Java

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: is compiled down to bytecode. Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Okay. So it's a process that probably has to do with the fact that when Syke was originally

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: written and you built up a powerful system, there is some technical depth you have to

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: deal with, as is the case with most powerful systems that span years. Have you ever considered-

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: this would help me understand because from my perspective, so much of the value of everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: you've done with Syke and Sykeorp is the knowledge. Have you ever considered just throwing away

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: the code base and starting from scratch? Not really throwing away, but sort of moving it

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to- like throwing away that technical debt, starting with a more updated programming language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Is that throwing away a lot of value or no? What's your sense? How much of the value is

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: in the silly software engineering aspect and how much of the value is in the knowledge?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So development of programs in Lisp proceeds, I think, somewhere between a thousand and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: fifty thousand times faster than development in any of what you're calling modern or improved

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: computer languages. Well, there's other functional languages

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: like Clojure and all that. But I mean, I'm with you. I like Lisp. I just wonder how many

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: great programmers there are. They're still like-

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Yes. So it is true when a new inference programmer comes on board, they need to learn some of

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And so it does not take programmers very long at all to learn Sub-L. And that's something

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: which can then be translated efficiently into Java. And for some of our programmers who

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: are doing, say, user interface work, then they never have to even learn Sub-L. They

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: just have to learn APIs into the basic psych engine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So you're not necessarily feeling the burden of like, it's extremely efficient. That's

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: not a problem to solve. Right. The other thing is, remember that we're

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: talking about hiring programmers to do inference who are programmers interested in effectively

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: automatic theorem proving. And so those are people already predisposed to representing

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: things in logic and so on. And Lisp really was the programming language based on logic

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: that John McCarthy and others who developed it basically took the formalisms that Alonzo

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Church and other philosophers, other logicians had come up with and basically said, can we

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: basically make a programming language which is effectively logic? And so since we're talking

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: about reasoning about expressions written in this epistemological language and we're

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: doing operations which are effectively like theorem proving type operations and so on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: there's a natural impedance match between Lisp and the knowledge the way it's represented.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I guess you could say it's a perfectly logical language to use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Oh yes. Okay, I'm sorry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I'll even let you get away with that. I appreciate it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So I'll probably use that in the future without credit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But no, I think the point is that the language you program in isn't really that important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It's more that you have to be able to think in terms of, for instance, creating new helpful

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: HL modules and how they'll work with each other and looking at things that are taking

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: a long time and coming up with new specialized data structures that will make this efficient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So let me just give you one very simple example, which is when you have a transit of relation

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: like larger than, this is larger than that, which is larger than that, which is larger

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: than that, so the first thing must be larger than the last thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Whenever you have a transit of relation, if you're not careful, if I ask whether this

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: thing over here is larger than the thing over here, I'll have to do some kind of graph walk

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: or theorem proving that might involve like five or 10 or 20 or 30 steps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But if you store, redundantly store the transitive closure, the cleanest star of that transit

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of relation, now you have this big table, but you can always guarantee that in one single

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: step you can just look up whether this is larger than that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And so there are lots of cases where storage is cheap today, and so by having this extra

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: redundant data structure, we can answer this commonly occurring type of question very,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: very efficiently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Let me give you one other analogy, analog of that, which is something we call rule macro

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: predicates, which is we'll see this complicated rule and we'll notice that things very much

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: like it syntactically come up again and again and again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So we'll create a whole brand new relation or predicate or function that captures that

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: and takes maybe not two arguments, takes maybe three, four, five arguments and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And now we have effectively converted some complicated if-then rule that might have to

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: have inference done on it into some ground atomic formula, which is just the name of

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: a relation and a few arguments and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And so converting commonly occurring types or schemas of rules into brand new predicates,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: brand new functions turns out to enormously speed up the inference process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So now we've covered about four of the 150 good ideas I said.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So that idea in particular is like a nice compression that turns out to be really useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That's really interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I mean, this whole thing is just fascinating from a philosophical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: This part of me, I mean, it makes me a little bit sad because your work is both from a computer

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: science perspective fascinating and the inference engine from a epistemological philosophical

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: aspect fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But it is also you're running a company and there's some stuff that has to remain private

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: and it's sad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Well, here's something that may make you feel better, a little bit better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: We formed a not-for-profit company called the Knowledge Activitization Institute, NAACS,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: KNAX.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And I have this firm belief with a lot of empirical evidence to support it that the

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: education that people get in high schools, in colleges, in graduate schools and so on

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: is almost completely orthogonal to, almost completely irrelevant to how good they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: going to be at coming up to speed in doing this kind of ontological engineering and writing

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: these assertions and rules and so on in psych.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And so very often we'll interview candidates who have their PhD in philosophy, who've taught

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: logic for years and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And they're just awful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But the converse is true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So one of the best ontological engineers we ever had never graduated high school.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And so the purpose of Knowledge Activitization Institute, if we can get some foundations

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to help support it, is identify people in the general population, maybe high school

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: dropouts who have latent talent for this sort of thing, offer them effectively scholarships

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to train them and then help place them in companies that need more trained ontological

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: engineers, some of which would be working for us, but mostly would be working for partners

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: or customers or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And if we could do that, that would create an enormous number of relatively very high

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: paying jobs for people who currently have no way out of some situation that they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: locked into.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So is there something you can put into words that describes somebody who would be great

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: at ontological engineering?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So what characteristics about a person make them great at this task?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: This task of converting the messiness of human language and knowledge into formal logic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: This is very much like what Alan Turing had to do during World War II in trying to find

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: people to bring to Bletchley Park, where he would publish in the London Times, cryptic

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: crossword puzzles along with some innocuous looking note, which essentially said, if you

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: were able to solve this puzzle in less than 15 minutes, please call this phone number

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Back when I was young, there was the practice of having matchbooks where on the inside of

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: the matchbook, there would be a, can you draw this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: You have a career in art, a commercial art.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: If you can copy this drawing and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So yes, the analog of that-

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Is there a little test to get to the core of whether it can be good or not?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So part of it has to do with being able to make and appreciate and react negatively appropriately

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to puns and other jokes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So you have to have a kind of sense of humor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And if you're good at telling jokes and good at understanding jokes, that's one indicator-

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Like puns?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Like dad jokes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Well, maybe not dad jokes, but funny jokes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I think I'm applying to work as a psych work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Another is if you're able to introspect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So very often we'll give someone a simple question and we'll say like, why is this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And sometimes they'll just say, because it is, okay, that's a bad sign.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But very often they'll be able to introspect and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So one of the questions I often ask is I'll point to a sentence with a pronoun in it and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I'll say, the referent of that pronoun is obviously this noun over here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: How would you or I or an AI or a five-year-old, 10-year-old child know that that pronoun refers

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to that noun over here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And often the people who are going to be good at ontological engineering will give me some

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: causal explanation or will refer to some things that are true in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So if you imagine a sentence like, the horse was led into the barn while its head was still

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: wet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And so its head refers to the horse's head.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But how do you know that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And so some people will say, I just know it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Some people will say, well, the horse was the subject of the sentence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And I'll say, okay, well, what about the horse was led into the barn while its roof was still

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: wet?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Now its roof obviously refers to the barn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And so then they'll say, oh, well, that's because it's the closest noun and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So basically if they try to give me answers which are based on syntax and grammar and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: so on, that's a really bad sign.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But if they're able to say things like, well, horses have heads and barns don't and barns

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: have roofs and horses don't, then that's a positive sign that they're going to be good

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: at this because they can introspect on what's true in the world that leads you to know certain

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: How fascinating is it that getting a PhD makes you less capable to introspect deeply about

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Oh, I wouldn't go that far.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I'm not saying that it makes you less capable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Let's just say it's independent of how good people are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: You're not saying that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I'm saying that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But it's interesting that for a lot of people, PhDs, sorry, philosophy aside, that sometimes

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: education narrows your thinking versus expands it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It's kind of fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And for certain, when you're trying to do ontological engineering, which is essentially

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: teach our future AI overlords how to reason deeply about this world and how to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: it, that requires that you think deeply about the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So I'll tell you a sad story about Mathcraft, which is why is that not widely used in schools

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: today?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: We're not really trying to make big profit on it or anything like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: We've gone to schools, their attitude has been, well, if a student spends 20 hours going

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: through this Mathcraft program from start to end and so on, will it improve their score

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221
