metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of problem after problem after problem?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And the answer is, well, no, but it'll increase their understanding more and their attitude

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: is, well, if it doesn't increase their score on this test, then we're not going to adopt

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That's sad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I mean, that's a whole another three, four-hour conversation about the education system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But let me ask you, let me go super philosophical as if we weren't already.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So in 1950, Alan Turing wrote the paper that formulated the Turing test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And he opened the paper with the question, can machines think?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So what do you think?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Can machines think?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Let me ask you this question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Machines can think, certainly as well as humans can think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Here meat machines, just because they're not currently made out of meat is just an engineering

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: solution decision and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So of course machines can think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I think that there was a lot of damage done by people misunderstanding Turing's imitation

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: game and focus on trying to get a chat bot to fool other people into thinking it was

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: human and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That's not a terrible test in and of itself, but it shouldn't be your one and only test

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: for intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So in terms of tests of intelligence, with the Lobner Prize, which is a very kind of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: you want to say a more strict formulation of the Turing test as originally formulated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And then there's something like Alexa Prize, which is more, I would say a more interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: formulation of the test, which is like, ultimately the metric is how long does a human want to

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: talk to the AI system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So it's like, the goal is you want it to be 20 minutes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So basically not just have a convincing conversation, but more like a compelling one or a fun one

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: or an interesting one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That seems like more to the spirit maybe of what Turing was imagining.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But what for you do you think in the space of tests is a good test?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: When you see a system based on psych that passes that test, you'd be like, damn, we've

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: created something special here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: The test has to be something involving depth of reasoning and recursiveness of reasoning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: the ability to answer repeated why questions about the answer you just gave.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: How many why questions in a row can you keep answering?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And also-

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Just have like a young curious child and an AI system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And how long will an AI system last before it wants to quit?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And again, that's not the only test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Another one has to do with argumentation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: In other words, here's a proposition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Come up with pro and con arguments for it and try and give me convincing arguments on

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: both sides.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And so that's another important kind of ability that the system needs to be able to exhibit

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: in order to really be intelligent, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So there's certain, I mean, if you look at IBM Watson and like certain impressive accomplishments

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: for very specific tests, almost like a demo, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: There's some, like I talked to the guy who led the Jeopardy effort and there's some kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of hard coding heuristics tricks that you try to pull it all together to make the thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: work in the end for this thing, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That seems to be one of the lessons with AI is like, that's the fastest way to get a solution

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: that's pretty damn impressive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So here's what I would say is that as impressive as that was, it made some mistakes, but more

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: importantly, many of the mistakes it made were mistakes which no human would have made.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And so part of the new or augmented Turing tests would have to be, and the mistakes you

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: make are ones which humans don't basically look at and say, what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So for example, there was a question about which 16th century Italian politician blah,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: blah, blah, and Watson said Ronald Reagan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So most Americans would have gotten that question wrong, but they would never have said Ronald

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Reagan as an answer because among the things they know is that he lived relatively recently

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: and people don't really live 400 years and things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So that's I think a very important thing, which is if it's making mistakes which no

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: normal sane human would have made, then that's a really bad sign.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And if it's not making those kinds of mistakes, then that's a good sign.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And I don't think it's any one very, very simple test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I think it's all of the things you mentioned, all the things I mentioned, there's really

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: a battery of tests, which together, if it passes almost all of these tests, it'd be

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: hard to argue that it's not intelligent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And if it fails several of these tests, it's really hard to argue that it really understands

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: what it's doing and that it really is generally intelligent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So to pass all of those tests, we've talked a lot about psych and knowledge and reasoning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Do you think this AI system would need to have some other human-like elements?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: For example, a body or a physical manifestation in this world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And another one which seems to be fundamental to the human experience is consciousness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: the subjective experience of what it's like to actually be you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Do you think it needs those to be able to pass all of those tests and to achieve general

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It's a good question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I think in the case of a body, no, I know there are a lot of people like Penrose who

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: would have disagreed with me and others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But no, I don't think it needs to have a body in order to be intelligent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I think that it needs to be able to talk about having a body and having sensations and having

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: emotions and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It doesn't actually have to have all of that, but it has to understand it in the same way

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: that Helen Keller was perfectly intelligent and able to talk about colors and sounds and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: shapes and so on even though she didn't directly experience all the same things that the rest

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of us do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So knowledge of it and being able to correctly make use of that is certainly an important

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: facility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But actually having a body, if you believe that, that's just a kind of religious or mystical

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: belief.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: You can't really argue for or against it, I suppose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It's just something that some people believe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: What about an extension of the body, which is consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It feels like something to be here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But what does that really mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It's like, well, if I talk to you, you say things which make me believe that you're conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I know that I'm conscious, but you're just taking my word for it now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But in the same sense, psych is conscious in that same sense already where of course

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: it understands it's a computer program.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It understands where and when it's running.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It understands who's talking to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It understands what its task is, what its goals are, what its current problem is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: it's working on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It understands how long it's spent on things, what it's tried.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It understands what it's done in the past and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: If we want to call that consciousness, then yes, psych is already conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But I don't think that I would ascribe anything mystical to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Again, some people would.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But I would say that other than our own personal experience of consciousness, we're just treating

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: everyone else in the world, so to speak, at their word about being conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And so if a computer program, if an AI is able to exhibit all the same kinds of response

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: as you would expect of a conscious entity, then doesn't it deserve the label of consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: just as much?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So there's another burden that comes with this whole intelligence thing that humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: got is the extinguishing of the light of consciousness, which is kind of realizing that we're going

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to be dead someday.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And there's a bunch of philosophers like Ernest Becker who kind of think that this realization

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of mortality and then fear, sometimes they call it terror of mortality, is one of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: creative forces behind human condition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It's the thing that drives us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Do you think it's important for an AI system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: When Psych proposed that it's not human and is one of the moderators of its contents,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: there's another question it could ask, which is it kind of knows that humans are mortal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Am I mortal?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And I think one really important thing that's possible when you're conscious is to fear

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: the extinguishing of that consciousness, the fear of mortality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Do you think that's useful for intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Thinking like I might die and I really don't want to die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I don't think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I think it may help some humans to be better people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It may help some humans to be more creative and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I don't think it's necessary for AIs to believe that they have limited lifespans and therefore

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: they should make the most of their behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Maybe eventually the answer to that and my answer to that will change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But as of now, I would say that that's almost like a frill or a side effect that is not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: In fact, if you look at most humans, most humans ignore the fact that they're going

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to die most of the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Well, but that's like, this goes to the white space between the words.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So what Ernest Becker argues is that ignoring is we're living in an illusion that we constructed

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: on the foundation of this terror.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So we're escape life as we know it, pursuing things, creating things, love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Everything we can think of that's beautiful about humanity is just trying to escape this

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: realization that we're going to die one day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That's his idea and I think, I don't know if I 100% believe in this, but it certainly

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: rhymes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It seems like to me like it rhymes with the truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Yeah, I think that for some people that's going to be a more powerful factor than others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Clearly Doug is talking about Russians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And I think that-

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So I'm Russian so clearly it infiltrates all of Russian literature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And AI doesn't have to have fear of death as a motivating force in that we can build

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: in motivation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So we can build in the motivation of obeying users and making users happy and making others

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: happy and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And that can substitute for this sort of personal fear of death that sometimes leads to bursts

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of creativity in humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I think AI really needs to understand death deeply in order to be able to drive a car,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I think there's just some-

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: No, I really disagree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I think it needs to understand the value of human life, especially the value of human

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: life to other humans, and understand that certain things are more important than other

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So it has to have a lot of knowledge about ethics and morality and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But some of it is so messy that it's impossible to encode.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: For example, if there's a person dying right in front of us, most human beings would help

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: that person, but they would not apply that same ethics to everybody else in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: This is the tragedy of how difficult it is to be a doctor because they know when they

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: help a dying child, they know that the money they're spending on this child cannot possibly

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: be spent on every other child that's dying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And that's a very difficult to encode decision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Perhaps it can be formalized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Oh, but I mean, you're talking about autonomous vehicles, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So autonomous vehicles are going to have to make those decisions all the time of what

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: is the chance of this bad event happening, how bad is that compared to this chance of

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: that bad event happening, and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And when a potential accident is about to happen, is it worth taking this risk if I

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: have to make a choice?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Which of these two cars am I going to hit and why?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: See, I was thinking about a very different choice when I'm talking about fear of mortality,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: which is just observing Manhattan-style driving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I think that humans as an effective driver needs to threaten pedestrians' lives a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: There's a dance, I've watched pedestrians a lot, I worked on this problem, and it seems

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: like the, if I could summarize the problem of a pedestrian crossing is the car with this

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: movement is saying, I'm going to kill you, and the pedestrian is saying, maybe, and then

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: they decide and they say, no, I don't think you have the guts to kill me, and they walk

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: in front and they look away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And there's that dance, the pedestrian, this is a social contract, that the pedestrian

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: trusts that once they're in front of the car and the car is sufficiently, from a physics

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: perspective, able to stop, they're going to stop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But the car also has to threaten that pedestrian, it's like, I'm late for work, so you're being

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: kind of an asshole by crossing in front of me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But life and death is part of the calculation here, and that equation is being solved millions

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of times a day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Very effectively, that game theory, whatever that formulation is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I don't know if it's as simple as some formalizable game theory problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: It could very well be in the case of driving and in the case of most of human society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I don't know, but yeah, you might be right that the fear of death is just one of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: quirks of the way our brains have evolved, but it's not a necessary feature of intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Drivers certainly are always doing this kind of estimate, even if it's unconscious, subconscious,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of what are the chances of various bad outcomes happening?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: For instance, if I don't wait for this pedestrian or something like that, and what is the downside

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to me going to be in terms of time wasted talking to the police or getting sent to jail

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: or things like that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And there's also emotion, like people in their cars tend to get irrationally angry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That's dangerous, but think about this is all part of why I think that autonomous vehicles,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: truly autonomous vehicles are farther out than most people do because there is this

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: enormous level of complexity which goes beyond mechanically controlling the car.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And I can see the autonomous vehicles as a kind of metaphorical and literal accident

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: waiting to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And not just because of their overall incurring versus preventing accidents and so on, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: just because of the almost voracious appetite people have for bad stories about powerful

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: companies and powerful entities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: When I was at a coincidentally, Japanese fifth generation computing system conference in

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: 1987, while I happened to be there, there was a worker at an auto plant who was despondent

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: and committed suicide by climbing under the safety chains and so on and getting stamped

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: to death by a machine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And instead of being a small story that said despondent worker commits suicide, it was

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: front page news that effectively said robot kills worker because the public is just waiting

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: for stories about AI kills phonogenic family of five type stories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And even if you could show that nationwide, this system saved more lives than it cost

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: and saved more injuries, prevented more injuries than it caused and so on, the media, the public,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: the government is just coiled and ready to pounce on stories where in fact it failed

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: even if they're relatively few.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Yeah, it's so fascinating to watch us humans resisting the cutting edge of science and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: technology and almost like hoping for it to fail and cost the end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: This just happens over and over and over throughout history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Or even if we're not hoping for it to fail, we're fascinated by it and in terms of what

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: we find interesting, the one in a thousand failures much more interesting than the 999

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: boring successes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So once we build an AGI system, say psych is some part of it and say it's very possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: that you would be one of the first people that can sit down in the room, let's say with

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: her and have a conversation, what would you ask her?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: What would you talk about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Looking at all of the content out there on the web and so on, what are some possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: solutions to big problems that the world has that people haven't really thought of before

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: that are not being properly or at least adequately pursued?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: What are some novel solutions that you can think of that we haven't that might work and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: that might be worth considering?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That is a damn good question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Given that the AGI is going to be somewhat different from human intelligence, it's still

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: going to make some mistakes that we wouldn't make, but it's also possibly going to notice

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: some blind spots we have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And I would love as a test of is it really on a par with our intelligences, can it help

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: spot some of the blind spots that we have?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So the two part question of can you help identify what are the big problems in the world and

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: two, what are some novel solutions to those problems?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That are not being talked about by anyone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And some of those may become infeasible or reprehensible or something, but some of them

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: might be actually great things to look at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: If you go back and look at some of the most powerful discoveries that have been made like

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: relativity and superconductivity and so on, a lot of them were cases where someone took

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: seriously the idea that there might actually be a non-obvious answer to a question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So in Einstein's case, it was, yeah, the Lorentz transformation is known.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Nobody believes that it's actually the way reality works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: What if it were the way that reality actually worked?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So a lot of people don't realize he didn't actually work out that equation, he just sort

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of took it seriously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Or in the case of superconductivity, you have this V equals IR equation where R is resistance

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And it was being mapped at lower and lower temperatures, but everyone thought that was

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: just bump on a log research to show that V equals IR always held.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And then when some graduate student got to a slightly lower temperature and showed that

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: resistance suddenly dropped off, everyone just assumed that they did it wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And it was only a little while later that they realized it was actually a new phenomenon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Or in the case of the H. pylori bacteria causing stomach ulcers, where everyone thought that

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: stress and stomach acid caused ulcers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And when a doctor in Australia claimed it was actually a bacterial infection, he couldn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: get anyone seriously to listen to him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And he had to ultimately inject himself with the bacteria to show that he suddenly developed

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: a life-threatening ulcer in order to get other doctors to seriously consider that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So there are all sorts of things where humans are locked into paradigms, what Thomas Kuhn

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: called paradigms, and we can't get out of them very easily.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: So a lot of AI is locked into the deep learning machine learning paradigm right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And almost all of us and almost all sciences are locked into current paradigms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And Kuhn's point was pretty much you have to wait for people to die in order for the

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: new generation to escape those paradigms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: And I think that one of the things that would change that sad reality is if we had trusted

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: AGI's that could help take a step back and question some of the paradigms that we're

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: currently locked into.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Yeah, it would accelerate the paradigm shifts in human science and progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: You've lived a very interesting life where you thought about big ideas and you stuck

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: with them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: Can you give advice to young people today, somebody in high school, somebody undergrad,

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: about career, about life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: I'd say you can make a difference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: But in order to make a difference, you're going to have to have the courage to follow

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: through with ideas which other people might not immediately understand or support.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: You have to realize that if you make some plan that's going to take an extended period

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: of time to carry out, don't be afraid of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That's true of physical training of your body.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That's true of learning some profession.

metadata.title: Podcast: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221

body.input: That's also true of innovation.

body.input: The following is a conversation with Kamran Vafa, a theoretical physicist at Harvard specializing in string theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: He is the winner of the 2017 Breakthrough Prize in Fundamental Physics, which is the most lucrative academic prize in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Quick mention of our sponsors, Headspace, Jordan Harmadishow, Squarespace, and Allform.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Check them out in the description to support this podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: As a side note, let me say that string theory is a theory of quantum gravity that unifies quantum mechanics and general relativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: It says that quarks, electrons, and all other particles are made up of much tinier strings of vibrating energy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: They vibrate in 10 or more dimensions, depending on the flavor of the theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Different vibrating patterns result in different particles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: From its origins, for a long time string theory was seen as too good not to be true, but has recently fallen out of favor in the physics community.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Partly because over the past 40 years, it has not been able to make any novel predictions that could then be validated through experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Nevertheless, to this day, it remains one of our best candidates for a theory of everything, or a theory that unifies the laws of physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Let me mention that a similar story happened with neural networks in the field of artificial intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: where it fell out of favor after decades of promise and research, but found success again in the past decade as part of the deep learning revolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: So I think it pays to keep an open mind, since we don't know which of the ideas in physics may be brought back decades later and be found to solve the biggest mysteries in theoretical physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: String theory still has that promise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: This is the Lex Friedman podcast, and here is my conversation with Kamran Vafa.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: What is the difference between mathematics and physics?

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Well, that's a difficult question, because in many ways, math and physics are unified in many ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: So to distinguish them is not an easy task.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: I would say that perhaps the goals of math and physics are different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Math does not care to describe reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Physics does. That's the major difference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: But a lot of the thoughts, processes, and so on, which goes to understanding the nature and reality, are the same things that mathematicians do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: So in many ways, they are similar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Mathematicians care about deductive reasoning, and physicists or physics in general, we care less about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: We care more about interconnection of ideas, about how ideas support each other, or if there's a puzzle discord between ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: That's more interesting for us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: And part of the reason is that we have learned in physics that the ideas are not sequential.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: And if we think that there's one idea which is more important, and we start with there and go to the next idea, next one, and deduce things from that like mathematicians do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: we have learned that the third or fourth thing we deduce from that principle turns out later on to be the actual principle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: And from a different perspective, starting from there leads to new ideas, which the original one didn't lead to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: And that's the beginning of a new revolution in science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: So this kind of thing we have seen again and again in the history of science, we have learned to not like deductive reasoning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: because that gives us a bad starting point to think that we actually have the original thought process should be viewed as the primary thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: And all these are deductions like the way mathematicians sometimes do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: So in physics, we have learned to be skeptical of that way of thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: We have to be a bit open to the possibility that what we thought is a deduction of a hypothesis is actually the reason that's true is the opposite.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: And so we reverse the order.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: And so this this switching back and forth between ideas makes us more fluid about a deductive fashion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Of course, it sometimes gives a wrong impression like physicists don't care about rigor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: They just, you know, they just say random things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: You know, they are willing to say things that are not backed by, you know, the logical reasoning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: That's not true at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: So despite despite this fluidity in saying which one is a primary thought,

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: we are very careful about trying to understand what we have really understood in terms of relationship between ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: So that's that's that's an important ingredient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: And in fact, solid math being behind physics is, I think, one of the attractive features of a physical law.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: So we look for beautiful math underpinning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Can we dig into that process of starting from one place and then ending up at like the fourth step and realizing

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: all along that the place you started out was wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: So is that happen when there's a discrepancy between what the math says and what the physical world shows?

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Is that how you then can go back and do the revolutionary idea for different starting place altogether?

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Perhaps I give an example to see how it goes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: And in fact, the historical example is Newton's work on classical mechanics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: So so Newton formulated the laws of mechanics, you know, the force F equals to M.A.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: and his other laws. And they look very simple, elegant and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Later, when we studied more examples of of mechanics and other similar things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: physicists came up with the idea that the notion of potential is interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Potential was an abstract idea which kind of came.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: You could take its gradient and relate it to the force.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: So you don't really need that a priori, but it solved, helped some thoughts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: And then later, Euler and Lagrange reformulated Newtonian mechanics in a totally different way in the following fashion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: They said if you take if you want to know where a particle at this point and at this time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: how does it get to this point at the later time is the following.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: You take all possible paths connecting this particle from going from the initial point to the final point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: And you compute the action and what is an action.

metadata.title: Podcast: Cumrun Vafa: String Theory | Lex Fridman Podcast #204

body.input: Action is the integral over time of the kinetic term of the particle minus its potential.
