metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: all kinds of social issues,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: which could actually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: some of them could really threaten democracy, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Just to clarify, when you said killer robots,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: you mean autonomous weapon, weapon systems,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: so not Terminator.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So I think these short and medium term concerns

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: should be important parts of the public debate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Now, existential risk for me is a very unlikely consideration

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: but still worth academic investigation

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: in the same way that you could say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: should we study what could happen if meteorite

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: came to earth and destroyed it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So I think it's very unlikely that this is gonna happen

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: or happen in a reasonable future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: The sort of scenario of an AI getting loose

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: goes against my understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: of at least current machine learning

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and current neural nets and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: It's not plausible to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: But of course, I don't have a crystal ball

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and who knows what AI will be in 50 years from now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So I think it is worth that scientists

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: study those problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: It's just not a pressing question as far as I'm concerned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So before I continue down that line,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: I have a few questions there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: but what do you like and not like about Ex Machina

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: as a movie?

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Because I actually watched it for the second time

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and enjoyed it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: I hated it the first time

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and I enjoyed it quite a bit more the second time

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: when I sort of learned to accept certain pieces of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: to see it as a concept movie.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: What was your experience?

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: What were your thoughts?

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So the negative is the picture it paints of science

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: is totally wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Science in general and AI in particular.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Science is not happening in some hidden place

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: by some really smart guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: One person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: One person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: This is totally unrealistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: This is not how it happens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Even a team of people in some isolated place

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: will not make it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Science moves by small steps

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: thanks to the collaboration and community

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: of a large number of people interacting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: And all the scientists who are expert in their field

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: kind of know what is going on even in the industrial labs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: It's information flows and leaks and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: And the spirit of it is very different

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: from the way science is painted in this movie.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Yeah, let me ask on that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: It's been the case to this point

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: that kind of even if the research happens inside Google

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: or Facebook, inside companies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: it still kind of comes out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Ideas come out. Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Do you think that will always be the case with AI?

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Is it possible to bottle ideas to the point

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: where there's a set of breakthroughs

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: that go completely undiscovered

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: by the general research community?

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Do you think that's even possible?

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: It's possible, but it's unlikely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Unlikely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: It's not how it is done now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: It's not how I can foresee it in the foreseeable future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: But of course I don't have a crystal ball.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: And so who knows?

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: This is science fiction after all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: But usually science-

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: I think it's ominous that the lights went off

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: during that discussion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So the problem, again, there's a,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: one thing is the movie

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and you could imagine all kinds of science fiction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: The problem with, for me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: maybe similar to the question about existential risk,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: is that this kind of movie paints such a wrong picture

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: of what is actual, the actual science

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and how it's going on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: that it can have unfortunate effects

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: on people's understanding of current science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: And so that's kind of sad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: There's an important principle in research,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: which is diversity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So in other words, research is exploration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Research is exploration in the space of ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: And different people will focus on different directions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: And this is not just good, it's essential.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So I'm totally fine with people exploring directions

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: that are contrary to mine or look orthogonal to mine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: I am more than fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: I think it's important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: I and my friends don't claim we have universal truth

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: about what will,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: especially about what will happen in the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Now, that being said, we have our intuitions

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and then we act accordingly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: according to where we think we can be most useful

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and where society has the most to gain or to lose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So we should have those debates

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and not end up in a society where there's only one voice

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and one way of thinking and research money is spread out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So disagreement is a sign of good research, good science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So the idea of bias in the human sense of bias,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: how do you think about instilling in machine learning

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: something that's aligned with human values in terms of bias?

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: We intuitively as human beings have a concept

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: of what bias means, of what fundamental respect

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: for other human beings means,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: but how do we instill that

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: into machine learning systems, do you think?

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So I think there are short-term things

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: that are already happening

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and then there are long-term things that we need to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: In the short term, there are techniques

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: that have been proposed

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and I think will continue to be improved

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and maybe alternatives will come up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: To take data sets in which we know there is bias,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: we can measure it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Pretty much any data set where humans are being observed

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: taking decisions will have some sort of bias,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: discrimination against particular groups and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: And we can use machine learning techniques

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: to try to build predictors, classifiers

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: that are gonna be less biased.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: We can do it, for example, using adversarial methods

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: to make our systems less sensitive to these variables

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: we should not be sensitive to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So these are clear, well-defined ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: of trying to address the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Maybe they have weaknesses and more research is needed

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and so on, but I think in fact, they're sufficiently mature

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: that governments should start regulating companies

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: where it matters, say like insurance companies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: so that they use those techniques.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Because those techniques will probably reduce the bias,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: but at a cost, for example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: maybe their predictions will be less accurate

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and so companies will not do it until you force them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: All right, so this is short-term.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Long-term, I'm really interested in thinking

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: of how we can instill moral values into computers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Obviously, this is not something we'll achieve

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: in the next five or 10 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: How can we, there's already work in detecting emotions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: for example, in images, in sounds, in texts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and also studying how different agents interacting

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: in different ways may correspond to patterns of, say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: injustice, which could trigger anger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So these are things we can do in the medium term,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and eventually train computers to model, for example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: how humans react emotionally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: I would say the simplest thing is unfair situations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: which trigger anger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: This is one of the most basic emotions

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: that we share with other animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: I think it's quite feasible within the next few years

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: that we can build systems that can detect

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: these kinds of things to the extent

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: unfortunately that they understand enough

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: about the world around us, which is a long time away,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: but maybe we can initially do this

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: in virtual environments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So you can imagine like a video game

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: where agents interact in some ways,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and then some situations trigger an emotion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: I think we could train machines to detect those situations

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: and predict that the particular emotion

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: will likely be felt if a human was playing

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: one of the characters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: You have shown excitement and done a lot of excellent work

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: with unsupervised learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: but there's been a lot of success

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: on the supervised learning side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Yes, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: And one of the things I'm really passionate about

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: is how humans and robots work together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: And in the context of supervised learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: that means the process of annotation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Do you think about the problem of annotation

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: of put in a more interesting way

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: as humans teaching machines?

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Is there...

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Yes, I think it's an important subject.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Reducing it to annotation may be useful

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: for somebody building a system tomorrow,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: but longer term, the process of teaching,

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: I think is something that deserves a lot more attention

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: from the machine learning community.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So there are people who've coined the term machine teaching.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So what are good strategies for teaching a learning agent?

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: And can we design, train a system

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: that is gonna be a good teacher?

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: So in my group, we have a project called a baby AI

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: or baby AI game, where there is a game or scenario

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: where there's a learning agent and a teaching agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Yoshua Bengio: Deep Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #4

body.input: Presumably the teaching agent would eventually be a human,
